דחוה.def:
ב‎

בּ ב,‎, Bêth, 2nd letter; post Biblical Hebrew = numeral 2 (and so in margin of printed MT); ב֟‎ = 2000; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

I. בְּ‎,

preposition in (Moabite בּ‎, Syriac , Arabic , Ethiopic ) before tone-syllables in certain cases (Ges§ 102. 2) בָּ‎, with suffix בִּי‎; בְּךָ‎ (Ex 7:29; 2Sam 22:30; Psa 141:8 בְּכָה‎), in pause and feminine בָּךְ‎; בּוֺ‎ (once, Jer 17:24 Kt בֹּה‎), בָּהּ‎; בָּנוּ‎; בָּכֶם‎, [בָּכֶן‎]; בָּם בָּהֶם,‎ [also בָּהֵ֫מָּה‎ Exod 30:4; 36:1; Hab 1:16], בָּהֶן‎ 1Sam 31:7; Isa 38:16; Ezek 42:14 [15 times בָּהֵן‎ (FrMM 235), and thrice, Leviticus 5:22; Num 13:19; Jer 5:17, בָּהֵ֫נָּה‎]. Preposition denoting properly in, Greek ἐν, but applied in many derived and figurative significations. The senses expressed by בְּ‎ are grouped by the Rabbis in three classes, הַכְּלִי בֵּית‎ Beth vasculi, וְהַנְּגִיעָה הַדִּיבִּוּק בֵּית‎ Beth coniunctionis et viciniae, הָעֵזֶר בֵּית‎ Beth auxilii; and the same arrangement may be followed here, though the limits between the three classes are not clearly defined, and they sometimes overlap one another.

I. In:

1 strictly, of position in a place (which often is expressed more precisely by בְּתוֺךְ בְּקֶרֶב,‎), as בַּבַּיִת‎ in the house, בָּעִיר‎ in the city, בַּדּוּד‎ in the pot, בָּאָרֶץ‎ in the land, etc. constantly. Hebrew idiom also says בָּהָר‎ in the mountain Exod 24:18 etc., even in cases where we could hardly avoid saying on, as 1Kin 11:7; 19:11: so בְּחֹרֵב‎ Deut 1:16 and elsewhere; הָהָר בְּראֹשׁ‎ Exod 24:17; Psa 72:16. Preceded by a verb of motion (especially עָבַר‎) בְּ‎ = through, as Gen 12:6 and Abram passed through בָּאָרֶץ‎ in the land = passed through it, 13:17; 2Sam 24:2 +; in (= through) a gate, Isa 62:10; Jer 17:19; Micah 2:13. Figurative to speak בְּאָזְנֵי‎ in the ears of ...; to be good (or evil, etc.) בְּעֵינֵי‎ in the eyes of ...

2 of presence in the midst of a multitude, among, Exod 14:28 there was not left בָּהֶם‎ among them even one, Lev 26:36; 2Sam 15:31 Ahitophel בַּקֹּשְׁרִים‎ is among the conspirators, 2Kin 18:5 יְהוּדָה מַלְכֵי בְּכֹל‎. So בְּךָ‎ in thee (of Israel, collective) Deut 7:14; 15:4, 7; 18:10; 23:11; 28:54 (different from עִמָּ֑ח‎ beside thee Lev 25:35). — Specifically

a. of an individual, implying eminency among: Josh 14:15; Jer 46:18 Tabor among the mountains, 49:15; Prov 30:30; Song 1:8 בַנָּשִׁים הַיָּפָה‎ the fair one (= the fairest) among women, Lam 1:1: compare Luke 1:42. On 1Sam 17:12 see Dr.

b. hence with some verbs, when the action refers to only a part of the object, as בְּ הִכָּהַ‎ to smite among... i.e. to smite some of... (different from הִכָּה‎ with accusative); בְּ הָרַג‎ Psa 78:31; בְּ נָשָׂא‎ to bear in, i.e. to share in bearing, Num 11:17 and elsewhere; בְּ בָּנָה‎ to build in or at Zech 6:15; Neh 4:4; בְּ עָשָׂה‎ Exod 5:9; בְּ עָמֵל‎ to labour on Jonah 4:10; בְּ שָׁתָה בְּ, אָכַל‎ to eat or drink of Judg 13:16; Prov 9:5; בְּ חָלַק‎ to give a share in Job 39:17.

c. specifying the parts of which a whole consists (especially in P) Gen 7:21; 8:17; 9:10, 16; 17:23; Exod 12:19; Num 31:11, 26; Hosea 4:3.

3 with reference to the limits enclosing a space, within: Exod 20:10 בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ‎ within thy gates, Isa 56:5 בְּחוֺמוֺתַי‎ within my walls.

4 often pregn. with verbs of motion, when the movement to a place results in rest in it, into: after בָּא‎ Gen 19:8; Isa 19:23; נָתַן‎ Gen 27:17; שָׁלַח‎ to send Lev 16:22; in among Josh 23:7, 12; 1Kin 11:2. — Hosea 12:7 (an extreme case) בְּ שׁוּב‎ to return (and rest) in thy God, 1Sam 16:3 (unless לַזָּבַ֑ח‎ should be read, as 16:7). — בְּעַיִן עַיִן‎ (with) eye (looking) into eye Num 14:14; Isa 52:8; בְּפָנִים מָּנִים‎ Deut 5:4; פְ ׳עֵינֵי בְּ‎ the eyes of ... are upon, both in favourable (11:12; Psa 101:6) and hostile (Amos 9:8; Job 7:8) sense.

5 applied to time, as Gen 1:1 בְּרֵאשִׁית‎ in the beginning; 2:2 הַשְּׁבִיעִי בַּיּוֺם‎ on the seventh day; Judg 10:8 הַהִיא בַּשָּׁנָה‎ in that year; & constantly.

6 of a state or condition, whether material or mental, in which an action takes place: so often, בְּשָׁלוֺם‎ in peace Gen 15:15; בַּצָּרָה‎ in distress Psa 91:15; בְּתֻמּוֺ הָלַךְ‎ to walk in his integrity; Exod 5:19 בְּרָע‎ in evil case.

7 בְּ‎ introduces the predicate, denoting it as that in which the subject consists, or in which it shews itself (the Beth essentiae, — common in Arabic, especially with a participle or adjective and in a negative sentence: Qor 2:79 and God (appears) not as one remiss; 2:7 and they are not believers [compare French en — en honnête homme]; see WAG ii. § 56 a): namely

a. a primary predicate, Exod 18:4 the God of my fathers בְּעֶזְרִי‎ was my help, Psa 146:5; Hosea 13:9 (read בְעֶזְֶרךָ׃ מִי כִּי‎ with ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Che and others); Psa 68:5 שְׁמוֺ בְּיָהּ‎ his name consists in Yah, Job 23:13; 37:10. With the predicate in the plural (as plural of majesty) Psa 118:7 ׳י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י‎ J. is my great helper, 54:6 (see Che), Judg 11:35.

b. a secondary predicate, Exod 6:3 and I appeared unto them שַׁדָּ֑י בְּאֵל‎ as God Almighty, Num 26:53 בְּנַחֲלָה‎ as an inheritance, 34:2; Ezek 46:16; 47:14; Deut 10:22; 26:14 I have not put away therefrom בְּטָמֵא‎ as one unclean = while unclean, 28:62; Isa 40:10 יָבוֺא בְּחָזָק‎ he cometh as a strong one, Psa 35:2 (where see De) and rise up as my help, 35:16, 39:7; 55:19; Prov 3:26; Job 36:32 (De).

c. a predicate as accusative, Isa 48:10 I have refined thee בְכָ֑סֶף וְלֹא‎ but not as though silver, Ezek 20:41; Num 18:26; 36:2; Josh 13:6-7, 23:4; Ezek 45:1; 47:22 (twice in verse) (read יַמִּלוּ‎) 48:29 (see ᵐ5‎ Co) all בְּנַחֲלָה‎ (compare

b.), Psa 78:55 & allotted it נַחֲלָה בְּחֶבֶל‎ as a line of inheritance (i.e. as a measured inheritance). Isa 26:4 י עוֺלָמִים צוּר יהוה בְּיָהּ ׳כִּי‎ is different — for in Yah there is a rock of ages (compare Qor 4:7; 4:47 there is sufficiency in God as a patron).

d. in comparisons, Psa 37:20 consume away בֶּעָשָׁן‎ in the form of, as, smoke 78:33; 102:4; Job 34:36; 36:14.

II. Denoting proximity —

1 at, by (not very common): 1Sam 29:1 בָּעַיִן‎ by the spring; Ezek 10:15, 20 כְּבָר בִּנְהַר‎ by the river Chebar (1:3 עַל‎).

2 on: Gen 8:20; Num 23:2 בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ‎ on the altar; Judg 8:21 on the necks of the camels; 1Kin 2:5 and elsewhere בְּמָתְנָיו‎ on his loins; Isa 59:17 a helmet בְּראֹשׁוֺ‎ on his head.

3 often with verbs of touching, approaching, taking hold of, cleaving, etc., as תָּפַשׂ תָּמַךְ, מָּגַּע, קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, נָגַע, חָשַׁק, דָּבֵק, אָחַז,‎ (see these words).

4 with words expressing or implying an act of hostility —

a. against: Gen 16:12 בּוֺ כֹּל וְיַד בַכֹּל יָדוֺ‎ his hand against all, and the hand of all against him; מְּ יַד ׳הָֽיְתָה בּ‎ Deut 13:10; 1Sam 5:9; 18:17 +? verbs (q. v.) of fighting (רִיב נִלְחַם,‎), going up to invade (עָלָה‎), being angry (אַף חָרָה אָנַף, הִתְעַבֵּר,‎), sinning or acting treacherously (כִּחֵשׁ כִּזֵּב, שִׁקֵּר, מָּשַׁע, מָעַל, מָרָה, מָרַד, בָּגַד, חָטָא,‎), testifying (הֵעִיד עָנָה,‎), mocking (הֵתֵל הִלְעִיג,‎), feeling loathing (קוּץ‎), rebuking (גָּעַר‎: properly to protest loudly), speaking (דִּבֶּר‎: Num 12:8b), etc., & even (an extreme case) Hosea 7:14 בִי יָסוּרוּ‎ they turn aside (so as to be) against me. In a weaker sense בַּקִּיר מַשְׁתִּין‎ mingens ad parietem 1Sam 25:22 and elsewhere

b. down to, upon (super with accusative), especially in such phrases as בּוֺ דָּמָיו‎ Lev 20:9 and elsewhere his blood be upon him; בְראֹשׁוֺ דָּמוֺ‎ his blood be upon his head Josh 2:19; י (הֵשִׁיב בְּראֹשׁוֺ׳שׁוּב )‎ Judges 8:57 (רָעָה‎), 1Kin 2:33 (דָּם‎), 2:44 (רָעָה‎), Psa 7:17 (עֲמָלוֺ‎); מּ דֶּרֶךְ נָתַן ׳בְּראֹשׁוֺ‎ 1Kin 8:32 & often in Ezekiel, as Ezek 9:10; 11:21.

III. 1. With —

a. of accompaniment: Num 20:20 כָּבֵד בְּעַם‎ with much people, Josh 22:8; Judg 11:34; 1Kin 10:2; 2Kin 5:9; Jer 41:15; Exod 21:22 and he shall give בִּפְלִלִים‎ with arbitrators (arbitrators being employed), Isa 8:16 בְּלִמֻּדָֽי׃‎ with my disciples, i.e. having them present; Exod 8:1; 8:13; Jer 11:19 בְּלַחְמוֺ עֵץ‎ a tree with its sap; 1Kin 19:19 הֶעָשָׂר בִּשְׁנֵים וְהוּא‎ and he with the 12th.

b. often of what one takes or brings with one: Gen 32:11 בְּמַקְלִי‎ with my staff I passed over Jordan, Judg 11:34; 15:1; 1Sam 1:24; Isa 7:24; Micah 6:6 and elsewhere בְּ קִדֵּם‎ to go to meet with; בְּ בָּא‎ to come with Lev 16:3; Psa 66:13; 71:16. (In Arabic this usage is developed more fully than in Hebrew, and literally to come with, literally to go away with, are used idiomatically in the sense of to bring, and to take away respectively: WAG ii. § 56 b.) Hence בְּלֹא בִּבְלִי, בְּאֶפֶס, בְּאֵין,‎ = without.

c. of concomitant (or surrounding) conditions, as בְּחִמָּזוֺן‎ with (or in) haste; בְּצֶדֶק‎ with (or in) righteousness; בִּשְׁגָגָה‎ in error; שׁוֺפָר וּבְקוֺל בִּתְרוּעָה‎ 2Sam 6:15; often in such phrases as בְּצִדְקָֽתְךָ‎ Psa 31:2 in thy righteousness; בְּחַסְדְּךָ‎ in thy mercy Exod 15:13; — בְּאָשְׁרִי‎ with my happiness! = happy am I Gen 30:13; Psa 29:4 the voice of ׳י‎ is בַּכֹּחַ‎ with power = is powerful; Exod 32:12 בְּרָעָה‎ with evil purpose; Psa 73:8 בְרָע‎ in wickedness; 90:10 בִּגְבוּרֹת‎ with strength.

2 of the instrument or means: as

a. בַּחֶרֶב‎ with the sword Exod 5:3 etc.; בְּרַגְלַיִם‎ with the feet Isa 28:3; . . . בְּיַד‎ by the hand of ... (see below יָד‎); to stone בְּאֶבֶן‎ or בָּֽאֲבָנִים‎ with stones Lev 20:2; Num 14:10 etc.; בְּ שָׁתָה‎ to drink with a cup Gen 44:5; Amos 6:6 (compare in Aramaic Dan 5:2); to cry בְּגָרוֺן‎ with the throat Isa 58:1; to burn בָּאֵשׁ‎ in or with fire (often); to slay or to perish בָּרָעָב‎ through hunger or בַּדֶּבֶר‎ through pestilence Exod 16:3; Jer 21:9 + often (compare Job 27:15 יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ בַּמָּוֶת‎); to save with or by Judg 7:7; 1Sam 14:6.

b. idiomatic, with certain verbs, as בְּ שָׁחַק‎ to play with Job 40:29; בְּ עָבַד‎ to labour with a person (as with an instrument), i.e. to use him as a slave Exod 1:14; Jer 22:13; 27:7 and elsewhere; בְּ עָשָׂה‎ 18:23; Neh 9:24; Dan 11:7; Est 1:15; 2:11; 3:11; 6:6; & perhaps בְּ דִּבֶּר‎ (of God) to speak with one Num 12:2, 8a and elsewhere (see Ew§ 217 f. (3); DrSm ii. 23, 2). Further ביהוה הִתְנַבֵּא בַּבַּעַל,‎ to prophesy with or by ׳י‎ or Baal, ׳י‎ or Baal being the inspirer; דָּרַשׁ בְּ, שָׁאַל‎ to inquire or ask by means of a god (or oracle).

c. ביהוה‎ through ׳י‎ (= by His aid) in many connections, as Psa 18:30; 44:6; 56:5; 56:11; Psalm 60:14; Isa 26:13; 45:25; Hosea 1:7; Zech 10:12; with passive verbs Deut 33:29; Isa 45:17 (to be saved): and even of the immediate cause Num 36:2 to be commanded ביהוה‎ by ׳י‎, Gen 9:6 בָּאָדָם‎ by man shall his blood be shed (both unusual), Hosea 14:4.

d. allied is the use of בְּ‎ in such phrases as to bless, swear, speak, prophesy, etc., בְּשֵׁם‎ in the name of ... (i.e. the name being used or appealed to in the act) Deut 6:13; Jer 11:21, etc. (so to swear ביהוה‎ by ׳י‎ Josh 2:12 etc.,בִּימִינוֺ‎ Isa 62:8; to bless בְּךָ‎ with thee Gen 48:20, to swear with me Psa 102:9, i.e. using my name in oath, Jer 29:22); almost = in the authority and power of 1Sam 17:45; 25:5; 1Kin 21:8; Micah 4:5; Zech 10:12; Psa 20:6; 44:6; 89:25.

e. בַּמָּה‎ or בַּמֶּה‎ by means of what? how? Gen 15:8; Judg 6:15; 16:5-6, 10; 1Kin 22:21; Mal 2:17. בְּזֹאת‎ by means of this Gen 42:15, 33. Exod 7:17; Num 16:28; with this = on this condition Gen 34:15, 22; 1Sam 11:2; Isa 27:9.

3 of cost or price (the Beth pretii), the price, whether given or received, being treated as the instrumental means by which the act is accomplished, with, for, at the cost of: thus regularly

a. with שָׂכַר‎ hire Gen 30:16, מָּדָה‎ redeem Exod 34:20, אֵרֵשׂ‎ betroth 2Sam 3:14, קָנָה‎ buy 24:24; 1Kin 2:23 בְּנַפְשׁוֺ‎ at the cost of his life hath A. spoken this word, 2Sam 23:17 who went בְּנַפְשׂוֺתָם‎ at peril of their lives, Prov 7:23; Lam 5:9; Josh 6:26 יְיַסְּדֶנָּה בִּבְכֹרוֺ‎ at the price of his firstborn shall he lay its foundations, 1Chr 12:19 בְּרָאשֵׁינוּ‎ to the jeopardy of our heads he will fall away, etc.

b. with מָכַר‎ sell Deut 21:14; עָבַד‎ serve Gen 29:18, 20; Hosea 12:13; הֵמִיר‎ exchange Lev 27:10; Hosea 4:7 their glory I will exchange for ignominy, Psa 106:20; בְּנֶשֶׁךְ נָתַן‎ to give for interest Lev 25:37; Psa 15:5; in other connections Gen 23:9; 47:16f.; Isa 45:13; Lam 1:11; Cant 8:7; 8:11; Deut 19:21 בְּעַיִן עַיִן בְּנֶפֶשׁ נֶפֶשׁ‎ life for life, eye for eye; Isa 2:22 הוּא נֶחְשָׁב בַּמֶּה‎ at what is he to be accounted? 7:23 a thousand vines כָּ֑סֶף בְּאֶלֶף‎ at a thousand (shekels of) silver. — Hence (perhaps) the idiomatic usages בְשָׁנָה שָׁנָה‎ year for year, one year like another, annually Deut 15:20 and elsewhere; בְּיוֺם יוֺם‎ (late), בְּיוֺם כְּיוֺם‎ 1Sam 18:10; בְּפַעַם כְּפַעַם‎ (see מַּעַם יוֺם,‎); בְּחֹדֶשׁ חֹדֶשׁ‎ 1Chr 27:1.

4 rather peculiarly, in certain cases where the object of an action may be treated as the instrument by which it is accomplished: as בְּראֹשׁ הֵנַיעַ‎ to shake with the head Jer 18:6; Job 16:4 (as well as ראֹשׁ הֵנִיעַ‎ Psa 22:8); to open with the mouth Job 16:10, with the lips Psa 22:8; to gnash with the teeth Job 16:9 (to gnash the teeth Psa 35:16); to wink with the eye Prov 6:13 (to wink the eye, ib. 10:10); בְּקוֺל נָתַן‎ to utter with the voice Psa 46:7; 68:34; Jer 12:8 (but קוֺל נָתַן‎ is more common); to stretch out with the hand Lam 1:17; בַּמַּטֶּה הֵרִים‎ (unusual) Exod 7:20. So בְּשֵׁם קָרָא‎ to call with the name — in different senses, according to the context, namely, to proclaim 33:19; 34:5; Isa 44:5; Psa 49:12; to invoke Gen 4:26; 12:8; 1Kin 18:24-26 Isa 12:4; to name honourably 43:1; 45:3. compare Ew§ 282 d Ges§ 119. 3 b R. WAG ii. § 56 b β DeJob 31:12; Prov 20:30.

5 with a causal force, through, on account of: Gen 18:28 בַּחֲמִשָּׁה הֲתַשְׁחִית‎ wilt thou destroy on account of five the whole city? Lev 26:39; Num 16:26; Deut 9:4-5, 24:16 יוּמָֽתוּ׃ בְּחֶטְאוֺ אִישׁ‎ they shall be put to death, each because of his own sin (compare Jer 31:30; Ezek 3:18, see 18:17) 2Sam 3:27; 14:7 (compare Jonah 1:14) Isa 7:4 (|| מִן‎) 28:7 (|| מִן‎) 50:1; 53:5; 57:17; Jer 51:46; Psa 5:8; 5:11; 6:8 (|| מִן‎) 31:10; 32:3; 42:10; 90:9; 94:23. So in בִּגְלַל בַּאֲשֶׁר,‎ (see גָּלָל אֲשֶׁר,‎), & (sometimes) in בִּדְבַר‎ at, through, the word of ....

6 of the material with which a work is wrought, both absolute בַזָּהָב עָשָׁה‎ to work with gold Exod 31:4; 1Kin 7:14; and to make a thing with (in our idiom, of) gold Exod 38:8; Ezek 7:20; 1Kin 15:22 (בָּנָה‎). Without a verb Lev 13:52; 2Chr 9:18.

7 with for although, in spite of (compare German bei alle dem): Lev 26:27; Num 14:11 הָאֹתוֺת בְּכֹל‎ in spite of all the signs that I have wrought, Deut 1:32; Isa 47:9; Psa 27:3; especially in the phrase בְּכָלזֿאת‎ for all this Isa 5:25; 9:11; 9:16; 9:20; 10:4; Psa 78:32 and elsewhere (compare in Arabic Qor 9:25.)

8 of a standard of measurement or computation, with, by: Exod 12:4 נְפָשֹׁת בְּמִכְסַת‎ by the computation of souls; Leviticus 5:25 and elsewhere בְּעֶרְכְּךָ‎ by thy reckoning; Ezek 4:10; בְּמִסְמָּר‎ by number Deut 25:2 +; . . . בְּמִסְמַּר‎ by the number of ... Lev 25:15, 50; Num 1:2, etc.; הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּשֶׁקֶל‎ Exod 30:13 and elsewhere (in P); בָּאַמָּה‎ often (see אַמָּה‎); Deut 3:11 אִישׁ בְּאַמַּת‎ by the cubit of a man; 2Sam 14:26 הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּאֶבֶן‎. Of a model, Gen 1:26 בְּצַלְמֵנוּ‎ in our image, 5:1, 3; Exod 25:40; בְּדֶרֶךְ‎ with the way (= in the manner) of ... Isa 10:24, 26; Amos 4:10.

IV. בְּ‎ is used also with certain classes of verbs, though the explanation of its use may be sometimes doubtful: namely

a. with verbs of taking refuge, trusting, relying, as נִשְׁעַן חָסָה, בָּטַח, הֶאֱמִין,‎.

b. with verbs of ruling, governing, restraining, as שָׁלַט רָדָה, עָצַר, נָגַשׂ, מָשַׁל, מָלַךְ,‎.

c. with verbs of rejoicing, feeling pleasure or satisfaction, etc., as שָׂבַע רָצָה, חָפֵץ, שָׂמֵחַ, שׂוּשׂ, עָלַץ, גִּיל,‎ (but with this verb מִן‎ is more common). [Probably a case of

III. 5.]

d. with verbs expressive of sensible perception, to denote the pleasurable or attentive exercise of the faculty concerned, as בְּ שָׁמַע‎ to listen to, חָזָה רָאָה, בְּ, הִבִּיט‎, to look upon, בְּ הֵרִיחַ‎ to smell at (see these words).

e. occasionally also with verbs of speaking, thinking, mentioning, knowing, to denote the object of the action, as בְּ דִּבֶּר‎ to speak about Deut 6:7; Psa 87:3 and elsewhere (see below דִּבֶּר‎); שִׂיחַ הָגָה, בְּ, הִלֵּל‎ 44:9; 63:7; 69:13; יָדַע‎ Jer 38:24; זָכַר‎ once 3:16, הִזְכִּיר‎ often; Psa 71:6 תְהִלָּתִי בְּךָ‎ of thee is my praise.

V. Followed by an infinitive with, בְּ‎ forms a periphrasis for the gerund, though in English it is commonly to be rendered by a verb and conjunction, namely: —

1 as a temporal conjunction, as Gen 2:4 בְּהִבָּֽרְאָם‎ in their being created = when they were created, 4:8 בִּהְיוֺתָם‎ in their being (= when they were) in the field; and constantly. Sometimes it has in appearance the force of after that, as 33:18; Exod 3:12; 13:17; but as a rule this is really due to the action denoted by the infinitive being treated as extending over a period within which the action of the principal verb takes place: so especially in the phrase מִמִּצְרַיִם יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּצֵאת‎, even of events at the close of the 40 years, Deut 4:45; 23:5; Josh 5:4, the whole period being treated as that in which Egypt was left (compare 2Kin 2:1, where the time included is future). Cases, however, occur in which this explanation will hardly apply, as Deut 27:4; 24:12.

2 as a causal conjunction (compare above

III. 5), as Gen 19:16 עָלָיו י ׳בְּחֶמְלַת‎ through J.'s having compassion upon him, Exod 16:7; 33:16; 34:29; Deut 1:27 י ׳בְּשִׂנְאַת אֹתָנוּ‎ through J.'s hating us, etc. (9:28 similarly מִן‎), 1Kin 18:18 (= in that ye have ...) Ezek 9:8; 43:8; 44:7; 2Chr 28:6.

3 as a concessive conjunction, when = though: Isa 1:15; Psa 46:3 אָ֑רֶץ בְּהָמִיר‎ though the earth do change.

Note. — Exod 10:12 בָּאַרְבֶּה‎ can only be rendered 'with the locusts,' the locusts being conceived as implicit in Moses' uplifted hand: but probably לָאַרְבֶּה‎ should be read. Thrice in late Hebrew בְּ‎ is used peculiarly: 1Chr 7:23 for with misfortune was it in his house (בְּרָעָה‎ chosen for the purpose of explaining בְּרִיעָה‎); 9:33 בַּמְּלָאכָה עֲלֵיהֶם‎ it devolved upon them with the work; Ezra 3:3 for with terror (was it) upon them from the peoples of the countries (the sentence without a verb as often in Chronicles: DrIntr. 504 f.): compare 8:34. compare Ew§ 295 f.

דחח.def:
H5080. nadach

[נָדַח‎] verb impel, thrust, banish (especially Deuteronomy, Jeremiah and later) (Late Hebrew id., beguile, Hiph, Niph`al; Aramaic נְדַח‎ (rare) = Biblical Hebrew; Ethiopic ; thrust; Arabic is drive a ship to shore); —

Qal Imperfect יִדַּח‎ 2Sam 14:14; Infinitive לִנְדֹּחַ‎ Deut 20:19; — transitive

1 impel (i.e. wield) an axe, followed byעַלֿ‎ Deut 20:19;

2 thrust away, banish followed byמִןֿ‎ 2Sam 14:14.

Niph`al Perfect3feminine singular נִדְּחָה‎ Job 6:13, etc.; (Imperfect יִדַּ֫חוּ‎ Jer 23:12 see דחח‎); Participle נִדָּח‎ 2Sam 14:14; נִדָּחָה‎ Micah 4:6 2t.; נִדַּ֫חַת‎ Ezek 34:4, 16, etc. On נִדְחֵי‎ Isa 11:12; 56:8; Psa 147:2 see Ki Köi. 317; —

1 be impelled: בַּגַּרְוֶן יָרוֺ וְנִדְּחָה‎ be impelled with the axe Deut 19:5.

2 be thrust out, banished: of dispersion in exile, followed by שָׁם‎ Jer 40:12; 43:5 (|| שׁוּב‎); followed by לִפְנֵי‎ 49:5 (|| קִבֵּץ‎); compare also figurative מִמֶּנִּי נִדְּחָה תֻּשִׁיָּה‎ Job 6:13 is banished from me, i.e. is non-existent; especially Participle banished one(s), outcast(s), as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with נָדַח‎2Sam 14:14; with קִבֵּץ‎ Micah 4:6; Deut 30:4; Zeph 3:19; Neh 1:9; ׳נ יִשִׂרָאֵל‎, with אָסַף‎ Isa 11:12 (|| יְקַבֵּץ נְפֻצוֺת‎); with קִבֵּץ‎ 56:8; with כִּנֵּס‎ Psa 147:2; with הֵשִׁיב‎ 2Sam 14:13; Ezek 34:4, 16 (both || אֹבֵד‎); with בּוֺא‎ Isa 27:13 (|| id.); see also 16:3-4, Jer 49:36; outcast = neglected one, figurative of Zion 30:17 (|| לָהּ אֵין דֹּרֵשׁ‎).

3 driven away (from herd, i.e.) straying Deut 22:1.

4 thrust away, aside from ׳י‎ to idiolatry Deut 4:19; 30:17 (followed by וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוָה‎).

Pu`al Participle מְנֻדָּח אֲקֵלָה‎ Isa 8:22 thrust into darkness.

Hiph`il Perfect וְהִדִּיחַ‎ consecutive 2Sam 15:14; הִדַּ֫חְתִּי‎ Jer 23:3; 29:14, etc.; Imperfect suffix וַיַּדַּח‎2Chr 21:11 + 2Kin 17:21 Qr; וַיַּדִּ֫יחוּ‎ Deut 13:14, etc.; Imperative suffix הַדִּיחֵ֫מוֺ‎ Psa 5:11; Infinitive הַדִּיחַ‎ 62:5, etc.; —

1 thrust, move, impel, figurative, object רָעָה‎ 2Sam 15:14 (followed by עַלֿ‎.

2 thrust out, banish, especially of exile, subject ׳י‎, with accusative followed by שָׁ֫מָּה‎ Deut 30:1; Jer 46:28; 16:15 (|| הֶעֱלָה‎); followed by שָׁם‎ 8:3; 24:9; 29:18; Dan 9:7 + Ezek 4:13 (omitted by ᵐ5‎ Co); Jer 23:3 (|| קִבֵּץ‎), 23:8 (|| הֵבִיא הֶעֱלָה,‎) 29:14 (|| הֵשֹׁיב קִבֵּץ,‎), so 32:37; also 27:10 (|| הַרְחִיק‎), 27:15 (|| אָבַד‎), compare 23:2 (Judah under figure of flock, subject evil shepherd, || הֵפִיץ‎), 50:17 (Israel as sheep, subject enemies as lions); of driving out priests 2Chr 13:9; invader Joel 2:20 (followed by אֶלֿ‎); wicked Psa 5:11 (|| הַאֲשִׁימֵם‎); good man from his eminence 62:5 (followed by מִן‎).

3 thrust away, aside, from ׳י‎ to idolatry, with accusative, Deut 13:14; followed by מִןהַֿדֶּרֶךְ‎ 13:6; י ׳מֵעַל‎ 13:11; י ׳מֵאַחֲרֵי‎ 2Kin 17:21 Qr (Kt see נדא‎); compare 2Chr 21:11 (|| הִזְנָה‎).

4 compel, force, subject adulteress (by flattery), followed by accusative Prov 7:21 (|| הִטָּה‎).

Hoph`al Participle מֻדָּח‎ chased, hunted, מ ׳צְבִי‎ Isa 13:14, simile of fugitive Babylonians.

די.def:
H1768. di

דִּי‎ particle of relation, who, which, that, used also as

mark of Genitive and

conjunction that, because (Aramaic of Nineveh, Babylonian, Zinjirli, Nerab, Cilicia, Têma, Egypt, ןי‎ (Lzb267. 446 RES361 S-CPap. A 2 +); Nabataean, Palmyrene די‎; דְּ ᵑ7‎ (except in compounds, as דִּילִי‎ mine, דִּילֵיהּ‎ his); Samaritan ; Syriac ; Ethiopic za: of same origin as Arabic possessor of [compare below Biblical Hebrew זֶה‎]. Properly a demonstrative that [compare זֶה‎; in Ethiopic ze is 'this', za 'which']; but this being referred by usage to something preceding becomes equivalent to the relative who, which, used, however, more widely than Hebrew אֲשֶׁר‎); — 1 as rel. who, which (construed like אֲשֶׁר‎): a. Jer 10:11; Dan 2:11 מְדָֽרְהוֺן דִּי‎ whose dwelling, 2:24 מַלְבָּא מַנִּי דִּי‎ whom the king had appointed, 2:26 בּ שְׁמֵהּ ׳דִּי‎ whose name was B., 4:5; 5:12, 23, etc.; = that which 2:23; = him that Ezra 7:25; 6:15; Dan 7:17 אַרְבַּע אִנוּן דִּת‎ which are four (see אִנּוּן‎). Following pronoun of 2 person (compare אֲשֶׁר‎ 3), 2:37 thou, O king ..., לָח יְהַב ֗֗֗ דִּי‎ to whom... hath given, 4:19; 4:6 as to whom I know, etc. (compare אֲשֶׁר‎ 4d end). Sq. תַּמָּה‎ = where Ezra 6:1, so דִּי‎ alone 6:3; Dan 2:38; of time, דִּי בְּעִדָּנָא‎ at the time when, etc., 3:5, 15. With the predicate an infinitive with לְ‎, 6:9 לְהַשְׁנָיָה לָא דִּי כְּתָבָא‎ which is not to be changed, Ezra 6:8; a place- or other determination, Dan 3:20 valiant men בְחֵילֵהּ‎ that were in his army, 5:2 בִירוּשְׁלֵב דִּי הֵיכְלָא‎, 7:20; Ezra 4:24; 5:6; 6:2, 6; compare Dan 2:25; 5:13; 7:7; Ezra 7:23. לָא דִּי‎ = without, 6:9; 7:22 (so ᵑ7 דְּלָא‎ Gen 15:2; Exod 21:11); compare Dan 2:34, 45. b. דִּי מָה דִּי, מָן‎ (compare in late Hebrew מַה ׳מַהשֶּֿׁ,‎ 1e b) whoever, whatever, so 3:6, 11 ָ(מןדִּֿילָֿא יִמֵּל‎ whoever does not fall down, 4:14 יִצְבֵּא דִּי לְמָן‎ to whomsoever he willeth, 4:22; 4:29; 5:21; דִי מָה‎ whatever (or simply what), 2:28 לֶהֱוֵא דִּי מָה‎ what will be, 2:29; 2:29; 2:45; Ezra 6:8; 7:18. — compare K§ 103. 2 as

mark of the Genitive, Dan 2:15 מלכא די שׁליטא‎ properly the captain, that of the king = the king's captain (a Genuine Aramaic idiom: so דְּ ᵑ7‎, Syriac constantly), 2:19; 2:25; 2:49 +? Ezra 4:15; 5:2, etc., or in the absolute state (undetermined), Dan 5:5; 7:4, 9, 10 נוּר דִּי נְהַר‎; or it may have a pleonastic suffix, 2:20 אֱלָהָא דִּי שְׁמֵהּ‎ literally his name, that of God = God's name, 2:44; 3:8, 25, 26; 4:23, etc. (so also ᵑ7‎ Syriac). To circumscribe an adjective, especially in specification of the material: 2:38 thou art דַהֲבָא דִּי רֵאשָׁה‎ the head of gold, 2:39; 3:1; 5:7, 16; Ezra 5:14; 6:4 +; as predicate Dan 2:32 טָב דִּידְֿהַב רֵאשֵׁהּ‎ his head (was) of fine gold, 2:33; 7:19; with a pronoun 2:20 wisdom and might הִיא דִּילֵֿהּ‎ are his; compare 6:27 תִתְחַבַּל דִּילָֿא וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ‎ his kingdom (is one) which shall not be destroyed, 7:14. — See further K§ 81. 3 as

conjunction (compare אֲשֶׁר‎ 8):

a. that (quod), after verbs of knowing, Dan 2:8-9, seeing 2:45; 3:27, hearing 5:14, etc.; introducing the subject of a sentence, ֗֗֗ דִּי ֗֗֗ יְדִיעַ‎ 3:18; Ezra 4:13; Dan 2:47 ֗֗֗ דִּי מִןקְֿשֹׁט‎ True is it that . . . (compare כִּי אָמְנָם‎ Job 12:2).

b. = in that, inasmuch as, whereas: Dan 2:41 and whereas (דִּי‎) thou sawest, etc. . . . it shall be adivided kingdom, 2:43; 4:20; 4:23; as a connecting link$ = seeing that, because, for (compare אֲשֶׁר‎ 8c) 2:9, 20b; 2:23b; 2:47b; 4:15; 6:24b.

c. that (ut), after verbs of asking Dan 2:16, commanding 3:10, 29, expressing a purpose 4:3; 5:15; Ezra 4:15; 6:10 +; לָא דִּי‎ that not (ne) Dan 2:18; 3:28; 6:18 (on לְמָה דִּי‎ lest Ezra 7:23, see מה‎).

d. prefixed to direct narr. (like כִּי‎ 1b, and sometimes אֲשֶׁר‎ 8a γ, and ὅτι recitativum), Dan 2:25 and said thus unto him דִּיהַֿשְׁכַּחַת‎ (that) I have found, etc., 5:7; 6:6; 6:14.

4 with prepositions and other prefixes:

a. דִי כְּ‎ (like Hebrew כַּאֲשֶׁר‎; so Egyptian Aramaic כזי‎, Palmyrene, Nabataean כדי‎, Lzb293 SACG1 62, 63 Cooke369b RES:361; כַּד ᵑ7‎, Syriac ); a according as, Dan 2:43; b. so soon as, when, 3:7; 5:20; 6:11; 6:15.

b. מִןדִּֿי‎: a. because that, Dan 3:22; Ezra 5:12 (compare מֵאֲשֶׁר‎ Isa 43:4); b. from (the time) that, after (ex quo), Dan 4:23; Ezra 4:23.

c. דִּי עַד‎ until, Dan 2:9, 34; 4:30; 7:22; = ere that 6:25.

d. דִּי עַל‎ Dan 3:19 is not a conjunction, but means above that which ...

e. for דִּי דִּבְרַת עַל‎ and דִּי כָּלקֳֿבֵל‎ see [ דִּבְרָה‎] and קֳבֵל‎.

כְּ‎ particle like, as, about (Biblical Hebrew כְּ‎, q. v.); — like, as Dan 2:40 כְּפַרְוְלָא תַּקִּיפָא‎, 4:5; 4:32; 5:1 +; according to 4:32 עָכֵד מִצְבְּיֵהּ וּכְּ‎ and according to his will he doeth, Ezra 6:9, 18 +; about (as Biblical Hebrew 1a: compare Zinjirli Lzb444 [ן‎] מלכ כשלשן‎), Dan 4:16 חֲדָה כְּשָׁעָה‎, 6:1; with infinitive (Biblical Hebrew 3b), 6:21 לִגֻבָּא מִקְרְנֵהּ וּכְ‎ and as he drew near, etc. Cpds.: — דִי כְּ‎ and כִּדְנָה‎, see דִּי‎ and דָּאנה‎; כַּחֲדָה‎; together, see חַד‎ (sub אחד‎).

דין.def:
H1732. David

דָּוִיד דָּוִד,‎1066

proper name, masculine David, son of יִשַׂי‎, king of Israel, whose dynasty remained on the throne of Jerusalem till the Babylonian exile (compare 2Sam 7:11-15 etc.) (beloved one ? compare BaNB 189; according to SayceModern Rev. 1884, 158 ff.; Rel. Babylonian 53, 56 f. originally Dodo, title of sun-god worshipped in Israel compare דודה‎ name of divinity among east Jordan Israelites MI12) — דָּוִד‎ always Ruth, Samuel, Kings (except 1Kin 3:14; 11:4, 36) Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Isaiah, Jeremiah; also 1Chr 13:6; Ezek 34:24; 37:24-25, (c. 790 t.); דָּוִיד‎ always Zechariah, Chronicles (except 1Chr 13:6), Ezra, Nehemiah; also Amos 6:5 (where gloss according to PetersHebraica. [דָּלָה‎] noun feminine door, only Qr דְּלָתְךָ‎ (Kt דלתיך‎) Isa 26:20 figurative, door of chamber in which people (personified) hides (compare also דֶּלֶת‎ dual)

דֶּ֫לֶת‎ noun feminine (? masculineNeh 13:19) door (Late Hebrew id.; Assyrian daltu(m) StrmAv 1843 SchrCOT Gloss; Phoenician plural דלהת‎ CISi. 7. 3; — according to BaZMG 1887, 607 from √ ידל‎, Assyrian edilu, to bolt, bar) — דֶּלֶת‎ (always absolute, and with article except Song 8:9 + Ezek 41:24 but here Co article) Gen 19:10 18t.; דָּ֑לֶת‎ 19:9; Judg 19:22; suffix דַּלְתּוֺ‎ 2Kin 12:10; Du. דְּלָתַיִם‎ (compare Sta§ 187 a) Deut 3:5 9t., דְּתָ֑יִם‎ Job 38:10; construct דַּלְתֵי‎ Josh 2:19 6t. + Ezek 26:2 Co; suffix דְּלָתַי‎ Job 31:32, דְּלָתֶיךָ‎ Zech 11:1 + Isa 26:20 Kt (compare דָּלָה‎ feminine noun), דְּלָתֶיהָ‎ Josh 6:26; 1Kin 16:34; plural דְּלָתוֺת‎ Jer 36:23 10t.; construct דַּלְתוֺת‎ Judg 3:23 19t. + Ezek 26:2 (Co דלתי‎); suffix דַּלְתֹתַי‎ Prov 8:34, דַּלְתוֺתָיו‎2Chr 3:7; 4:22; דַּלְתֹתָיו‎ Neh 3:1, 3, 6, 13, 14, 15; דַּלְתוֺתֵיהֶם‎2Chr 4:9;

1 door of house (distinguished from door-way, compare 1Kin 6:31 מֶּתַח‎ Gen 19:6) 19:9-10, Exod 2:6 (all J E) Deut 15:17; Josh 2:19 (JE) Judg 11:31; 19:22, 27; 1Sam 21:14 (השׁער דלתות‎) 2Kin 4:4-5, 6:32 (twice in verse); Isa 57:8; Job 31:32; so figurative of wisdom's house Prov 8:34 עַלדַּֿלְתֹתַי לִשְׁקֹד‎; particular doors of house of ׳י‎ 1Sam 3:15 (י ׳הֵיכַל‎ 3:3); temple 1Kin 6:34 (3 t. in verse); 7:50; 2Kin 18:16; 1Chr 22:3; 2Chr 3:7; 4:22; 28:24; 29:3; Neh 6:10; Mal 1:10; so of Ezekiel's temple, Ezek 41:23-24, (5 t. in verse); 41:25.

2 door of room Judg 3:23-24, 25; 2Sam 13:17-18, 2Kin 4:33; 9:3, 10. especially doors of דביר‎ or ׳ק קדשׁים‎ 1Kin 6:31-32, 7:50; 2Chr 4:22 compare also Ezek 41:23; also of court עֲזָרָה‎2Chr 4:9 (twice in verse), and of porch אוּלָם‎29:7.

3 gates of city Deut 3:5; Josh 6:26 (compare 1Kin 16:34) Judg 16:3; 1Sam 23:7; 2Chr 8:5; 14:6; Neh 3:1, 3, 6, 13, 14, 15; 6:1; 7:1 (׳ד‎ then Generally distinct from שׁער‎, which denotes the whole structure of gate, including posts, open space, etc., while ׳ד‎ is swinging door), 7:3; 13:19 (where also sense narrower than || שׁעת‎) Isa 45:1 (|| שׁערים‎) compare 45:2 and Psa 107:16; Jer 49:31; Ezek 38:11.

4 in other senses (mostly figurative): door (probably lid) of chest 2Kin 12:10; aperture of womb Job 3:10 (׳ד בטני‎); jaws of crocodile 41:6 (׳ד פניו‎); lips of man Eccl 12:4; doors enclosing and shutting off sea Job 38:8, 10; doors of heaven through which comes rain Psa 78:23 (compare השׁ ׳אֲרֻבֹּת‎ Gen 7:11); of column of MS. (from shape) Jer 36:23; figurative of easily accessible woman, Song 8:9; in simile Prov 26:14; of Jerusalem as gate of people Ezek 26:2; of Lebanon Zech 11:1.

דם.def:
H1818. dam

דָּם‎360 noun masculineGen 9:6 blood (Late Hebrew id., Arabic , Ethiopic Assyrian damu Nor239 ZimBP 72, 76; Aramaic דְּמָא דַּם,‎ , ) — absolute ׳ד‎ 37:22 154t.; construct דַּם‎ 9:6 62t.; suffix דָּמִי‎ 1Sam 26:20 3t.; דָּֽמְךָ‎ 2Sam 1:16 (Qr; Kt דמיך‎) + 4 t.; דָּמֵךְ‎ Ezek 16:22 3t.; דָּמוֺ‎ Gen 9:4 30t.; דָּמָהּ‎ Lev 4:30 (twice in verse) + 11 t.; דִּמְכֶם‎ Gen 9:5; דָּמָם‎ Lev 16:27 11t.; plural דָּמִים‎ Exod 4:25 35t.; construct דְּמֵי‎ Gen 4:10 18t.; suffix דָּמֶיךָ‎ 2Sam 1:16 Kt (Qr דָּֽמְךָ‎); דָּמַיִךְ‎ Ezek 16:6 (3 t. in verse); 16:9; דָּמָיו‎ Lev 20:9 3t.; דָּמֶיהָ‎ 12:7 2t.; דְּמֵיהֶם‎ 20:11 5t.; —

1 blood of man or animal, = the life (נֶפֶשׁ‎) Gen 9:4 (P) Deut 12:23; Lev 17:14 (twice in verse) (H); compare הִוא בַּדָּם הַבָּשָׂר נֶפֶשׁ‎ 17:11 (H) & לְנַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם דִּמְכֶם‎ Gen 9:5 (P); see also Psa 72:14 בְּעֵינָיו דָּמָם וְיֵיקַר‎; hence blood of animals not to be eaten Lev 3:17; 7:26-27,(all P) 17:10 (twice in verse); 17:12 (twice in verse); 17:14; 19:26 (all H) Deut 12:16, 23; 15:23; 1Sam 14:32-33, 34; Ezek 33:25 (compare RSK 310), but to be poured out & covered with dust Lev 17:13 (compare RSSemitic i. 216 f.).

2 usually blood become visible,

a. as from a wound ׳ד הַמַּכָּה‎ 1Kin 22:35 (compare דָּמִים חֲתַן‎ Exod 4:25-26, see below h); licked by dogs 1Kin 21:19 (twice in verse); 22:38; Ezek 32:6; from the nose Prov 30:33; bloody issue of a woman Lev 15:19 compare 15:25; plural טָֽהֳרָה דְּמֵי‎ 12:4-5, & דָּמֶיהָ מְקֹר‎ 12:7 (all P) 20:18 (H); blood in which child welters Ezek 16:6 (twice in verse); 16:22 + 16:6 (strike out A B Co and others); of goat Gen 37:31 (JE); of slain bird Lev 14:6, 51, 52.

b. often object of שָׁפַךְ‎, spill, shed Gen 9:6 (P) 37:22 (E) Num 35:33 (P) Lev 17:4 (H) Deut 21:7; 1Sam 25:31; 1Kin 18:28; 2Kin 21:16; 24:4; 1Chr 22:8; Ezek 16:38; 22:4, 6, 9, 12, 27; 23:45; 33:25; 36:18 (strike out B Co) Prov 1:16 also Psa 79:3 כַּמַּיִם דָמָם שָֽׁפְכוּ‎; דָּם שֹׁפֵךְ‎ a blood-shedder Ezek 18:10; דָּם שֹׁפֶכֶת עִיר‎ 22:3 compare 22:4 (also 1Kin 2:31; Jer 22:3, 17; 1Chr 22:8; 28:3; Prov 6:17; Lam 4:13); less often subject of passive נִשְׁמָּךְ שָׁפוּךְ,‎, etc. Gen 9:6; Num 35:33 (both P) Deut 19:10; Zeph 1:17; Psa 79:10.

c. חָלָל דַּם‎ Deut 32:42 (song) blood of slain; ׳ד חֲלָלִים‎ 2Sam 1:22 so Num 23:24 (JE), object of שָׁתָה‎, of Israel under figure of lion; compare also Ezek 39:17-18, 19, & 2Sam 23:17 = 1Chr 11:19 (הָאֲנָשִׁים דַּם‎ hyperbole for imperilled life); as food of young eagles Job 39:30.

d. often of innocent blood, i.e. blood shed with injustice & cruelty, נָקִי דָּם‎ Deut 21:8-9, 1Sam 19:5; 2Kin 21:16; 24:4; Psa 94:21; 106:38 compare Psalm 94:38; Prov 6:17; Isa 59:7; Jer 7:6; 22:3 (also 26:15); נָקִיא דָּם‎ Joel 4:19; Jonah 1:14; also in construct נָקִי דַּם‎ Deut 19:10; compare 27:25 ׳ד ׳נ נֶפֶשׁ לְהַכּוֺת‎; הַנָּקִי דַּם‎ 19:13; Jer 22:17; 2Kin 24:4; נְקִיִּים דַּם‎ Jer 19:4; נְקִיִּים אֶבְיוֺנִים נַפְשׁוֺת דַּם‎ 2:34; further צַדִּיקִים דַּם‎ Lam 4:13; חִנָּם דְּמֵי‎ 1Kin 2:31; in Psa 31:10 דָּמִי‎ = my death (|| אֶלשַֿׁחַת רִדְתִּי‎).

e. evenger of blood הַדָּם גֹּאֵל‎ Num 35:19, 21, 24, 25, 27 (twice in verse) (all P); Deut 19:6, 12; Josh 20:3, 5, 9; 2Sam 14:11.

f. plural דָּמִים‎ of abundance, blood in quantity, hence sometimes of blood shed by rude violence, and of blood-stains; — Gen 4:10-11,(J) as crying from the ground for vengeance (compare RSSemitic i. 397), compare also 2Sam 3:28; 16:8; 2Kin 9:26 (twice in verse); Isa 1:15; 9:4; 26:21; Ezek 16:6 (3 t. in verse); 16:9, 36 (on text of 16:6 see above) Zech 9:7; 2Chr 24:25; אָדָם דְּמֵי‎ Hab 2:8, 17, and in other connections; but interchangeably with singular 2Sam 3:27; 20:12; 2Kin 9:33; Isa 34:3, 6 (twice in verse); 34:7; Ezekiel 21:37; Ezek 22:13 (plural Co) 24:8 (twice in verse) and elsewhere; see especially דָמִי אַלתְּֿכַסִּי אֶרֶץ‎ Job 16:18; ירושׁלם דְּמֵי‎ blood-stains of Jerusalem Isa 4:4; = slaughter, singular Gen 37:26 (J) Jer 48:10; Ezek 5:17; 28:23 (|| דֶּבֶר‎) 38:22 (|| id.); דַּםעֲֿבָדָיו‎ Deut 32:43 (song: compare Psa 79:10); plural עֲבָדַי דְּמֵי‎ 2Kin 9:7 (twice in verse); יִזְרְעֶאל דְּמֵי‎ Hosea 1:4; bloodshed at Jezreel; compare נָגָ֑עוּ בְּדָמִים דָּמִים‎ 4:2; מִלְחָמָה דְּמֵי‎ 1Kin 2:5 (twice in verse); in Ezek 9:9 חָמָס הָאָרֶץ וַתִּמָּלֵא‎ (Baer) read דָּמִים‎ for חָמָס‎ see d. H. Vrss Co Comm.; לְדָם אָרַב‎ lie in wait for blood Prov 1:11 compare 1:18; 12:6; Micah 7:2; דָּמִים‎ of a plan of murder Isa 33:15 (object of שׁמע‎); דָּמִים מִשְׁמַּט‎ Ezek 7:23 bloody crime; as symbol of oppression, violence Micah 3:10 (|| עַוְלָה‎), Hab 2:12 (|| id.)

g. דָּמִים‎ = guilt of bloodshed, blood-guiltiness Exod 22:1, then more Generally, mortal sin (RSOTJC 417, 2nd ed. 441, compare Ezek 18:13) Psa 51:16 (compare Hosea 12:15); also בְדָמִים בּוֺא‎ 1Sam 25:26, 33.

h. plural also in pharses: דָּמִים חֲתַן‎ bloody bridegroom Exod 4:25-26, also those denoting character, chiefly in poetry, דָּמִים אִישׁ‎ bloody man (sanguinary) 2Sam 16:8; Psa 5:7 הַדָּמִים אִישׁ‎ 2Sam 16:7; דָּמִים אַנְשֵׁי‎, Psa 26:9; Psalm 55:24; 59:3; 139:19; Prov 29:10; הַדָּמִים ואלבֵּֿית‎ bloody house 2Sam 21:1 but read with ᵐ5‎ We Dr דמים בֵּיתֹה ואל‎, & on his house is blood; דָּמִים עִיר‎ Nahum 3:1; הַדָּמִים עִיר‎ Ezek 22:2; 24:6 + 24:9 (strike out B Co).

i. בּוֺ דָּמָיו‎ his blood is in (upon) him, he is responsible for his own death Lev 20:9 compare 20:11; 20:12; 20:13; 20:16; 20:27 (all H), Ezek 18:13 ( + יִהְיֶה‎); בּוֺ דָּמוֺ‎ 33:5; בְּראֹשׁוֺ דָּמוֺ‎ Josh 2:19 (twice in verse); so with שָׁבוּ‎ 1Kin 2:33, יִהְיֶה‎ 2:37; Ezek 33:4; ראֹשֶׁ֑ךָ עַל דָּֽמְ֯יךָ‎ 2Sam 1:16, and י ׳הֵשִׁיב עַלרֿאֹשׁוֺ אֶתדָּֿמוֺ‎ 1Kin 2:32; also בְּבֵיתְךָ דָּמִים תָשִׂים לֹא‎ Deut 22:8; and אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל לָשׂוּם דָּמָם‎ Judg 9:24; (אלׅ על דָּם נָתַן‎ Jer 26:15; Jonah 1:14; דָּמִים עָלָיךָ וְהָיָה‎ Deut 19:10, see 2Sam 21:1 above; also singular Ezek 22:4 אָשַׁמְתְּ בְּדָמֵךְ‎, and as subject of לְ יֵחָשֵׁב‎ shall be imputed to Lev 17:4 (H); דָמִים לוֺ אֵין‎ Exod 22:1 compare 22:2 (both J E) & (singular) Num 35:27 (P).

j. of judicial process in case of bloodshed לְדָם בֵּיןדָּֿם לַמִּשְׁמָּט דָּבָר‎ Deut 17:8 compare 2Chr 19:10; רֵעֶ֑ךָ עַלדַּֿם תַּעֲמֹד לֹא‎ Lev 19:16 (H).

k. in phrase require blood at the hand of, exact vengeance (for it) from, מִיַּד דָּמוֺ דָּרַשׁ‎ Ezek 33:6; Gen 9:5; נִדְרָשׁ דָּמוֺ‎ 42:22 (E); absolute דמים דֹּרשׁ‎ Psa 9:13; מִיֶּדְכֶם אֶתדָּֿמוֺ אֲבַקֵּשׁ‎ 2Sam 4:11 compare Ezek 3:18, 20; 33:8; ד ׳מָּקַד עַלֿ‎ Hosea 1:4; ד ׳וְנִקֵּיתִי‎ Joel 4:21; Ezek 35:6 (4 t. in verse); compare on the other hand י מְּנֵי מִנֶּגֶד אַרְצָה דָּמִי ׳אַליִֿמֹּל‎ 1Sam 26:20 i.e. let it not de unavenged.

l. of blood as defiling a land Num 35:33 (P) compare Psa 106:38 (plural בדמים‎); מִדָּם עֲקֻבָּה‎ Hosea 6:8 of a city foot-printed (VB) with blood; defiling hands Isa 1:15; 59:3; Lam 4:14 compare Ezek 23:37, 45; further, of blood as oppressing one who has shed it נֶפֶשׁ בְּדַם עָשֻׁק‎ Prov 28:17.

m. atonement for blood-guilt is expressed by הַדָּם לָהֶם וְנִכַּמֵּר‎ Deut 21:8 (on form of verb compare Ges§ 55, 9 & Di).

n. blood (-shedding) as connected with divine wrath בְּדָם עָלָיהָ חֲמָתִי וְשָׁפַכְתִּ֫י‎ Ezek 14:19; וְקִנְאָה חֵמָה דַּם‎ 16:38; see further מִדָּם חִצַּי אַשְׁכִּיר‎ Deut 32:42, compare Jer 46:10; compare also of human vengeance by divine help הָרָשָׁע בְּדַם יִרְחַץ‎ Psa 58:11; בְּדָם רַגְלְךָ תִּמֲחַץ‎ 68:24; note further Isa 49:26; Ezek 39:19 (in both figurative of being drunk with blood); then of simple human vengeance שְׁאוֺל בְּדָם אֶתשֵֿׂיבָתוֺ וְהוֺרַדְתָּ֫‎ 1Kin 2:9.

o. of water turned into blood (singular) in Egypt, by divine power Exod 4:9 (J) 7:17, 20 (JE) 7:19; 7:19; 7:21 (P) Psa 78:44; 105:29; compare Isa 15:9 & Ezek 32:6; further, of appearance of blood in sky Joel 3:3, & of colour of moon 2:4; specifically of red colour of water כַּדָּם אֲדֻמִּים‎ 2Kin 3:22 compare 3:23.

3 blood used with religious significance,

a. blood of passover-lamb Exod 12:7, 13 (twice in verse) (all P) 12:22; 12:22; 12:23 (all J E); note also הַבְּרִית דַּם‎, i.e. blood by which covenant was ratified 24:8 (JE) Zech 9:11.

b. blood used in ritual, Lev 17:11 יְכַמֵּר בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הוּא הַדָּם‎ (H); compare 2Chr 29:24; also Ezek 44:7, 15 (both || חֵלָב‎); further Lev 1:5; Isa 1:11; Psa 50:13; thrown on altar, verb זָרַק‎ usually with עַל‎ Exod 24:6 (JE) 29:16, 20; Lev 1:5, 11; 3:2, 8, 13; 7:2, 14; 8:19, 24; 9:12, 18 (all P) 17:6 (H) Num 18:17 (P) Ezek 43:18; 2Kin 16:13, 15 (twice in verse); 2Chr 29:22 (3 t. in verse); compare 30:16; sprinkled, verb הִזָּה‎ Lev 5:9; 16:19 (both P); sprinkled toward tent of meeting (verb הִזָּה‎) Num 19:4 (twice in verse) (P); brought into tent of meeting Lev 4:5, 16; 6:23; compare 10:18 (all P); sprinkled toward the holy of holies (verb הִזָּה‎) 4:6 (twice in verse); 4:17; 16:14 (twice in verse) (all P); brought within the veil on day of atonement 16:15 (3 t. in verse) (compare 16:14) 16:27 (all P); thrown on people Exod 24:8 (J E; זָרַק‎); sprinkled on priests (הִזָּה‎) 29:21; Lev 8:30 (both P); on garment (in sanctuary, הִזָּה‎) 6:20 (P); applied with finger to horns of altar Exod 29:12; Lev 4:7, 18, 25, 30, 34; 8:15; 9:9 (3 t. in verse); 16:18 (twice in verse) (all P; also Ezek 45:19) 43:20; applied to tip of right ear of priest Exod 29:20; Lev 8:23-24, (all P; also 14:14, 25 P); poured out at base of altar (אֶלֿ שָׁפַךְ‎) Exod 29:12; Lev 4:7, 18, 25, 30, 34 (all P); compare with מָצָה‎ (Niph`al) 1:15; 5:9; with יָצַק‎ 8:15 (all P); half of blood put in basons Exod 24:6 (JE); blood poured out on altar Deut 12:27 (twice in verse); blood of red heifer burned Num 19:5 (P); see further such terms as זִבְחִי דַּם‎ Exod 23:18; 34:25 (both J E) (compare Deut 12:27; 2Kin 16:15); הַשְּׁלָמִים דַּם‎ Lev 7:33 (P; compare 7:14); הַכִּמֻּרִים חַטָּאת דַּם‎ Exod 30:10 (P) compare Ezek 45:19; הָאָשָׁם דַּם‎ Lev 14:14, 17, 25, 28; (see אָשָׁם חַטָּאת, שֶׁלֶם, זֶבַח,‎); דַּםחֲֿזִיר‎, swine's blood, as heathen offering Isa 66:3; compare מִדָּם נִסְכֵּיהֶם‎ Psa 16:4 (see Che).

4 figurative of wine דַּםעֲֿנָבִים‎ Gen 49:11 (blessing of Jacob || יַיִן‎); compare Deut 32:14 (song) תִּשְׁתֶּהחָֿ֑מֶר עֵנָב דַּם‎. — בְּדָֽמְךָ‎ Ezek 19:10 probably textual error compare VB; Da prop: בְּרוּמָהּ‎ in her height.

דמה.def:
H1822. dummah

דֻּמָּה‎ noun feminine one silenced, brought to silence (?; destroyed?) הַיָּ֑ם בְּתוֺךְ כְּדֻמָּה כְצוֺר מִי‎ Ezek 27:32 (form pecul. & sense dubious: Baer כְּדֻמָֿה‎; Co כְּבֻדָּה‎ from כָּבֹד‎ adjective, compare 23:41; Psa 45:14) AV What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed (as though for מְדֻמָּה‎ compare ההללה‎ 26:1; but Pi`el Punic not elsewhere) in the midst of the sea? RV like her that is brought to silence. — DlBaer Ezech p.xi. & Pr 64 derived, hesitantly, from II. דמם‎.

דמות.def:
H1823. demuth

דְּמוּת‎ noun feminine likeness, similitude (mostly late) (according to LagBN 12. 147 ff. mispunct. for דִּמְוַת‎ from דִּמְוָה‎; according to WeProl. 413. Eng. Tr. 389 an Aramaic Loan-word, but see Di Gen 5:1, DrJPh xi. 216 CheOP. 474) — absolute ׳ד‎ Isa 40:18 3t.; construct ׳ד‎ Gen 5:1 16t.; suffix דְּמוּתוֺ‎ 5:3; דְּמוּתֵנוּ‎ 1:26; —

1 likeness, similitude, of external appearance, chiefly in Ezek.: Ezek 1:5 (likeness, i.e. something that appeared like) so 1:26; 8:2 (אֵשׁׅ כְּמַרְאֵה דְּמוּת‎ (compare Co), 10:1 ד ׳כְּמַרְאֵה כִּסֵּא‎; compare also Dan 10:16 אָדָם בְּנֵי כִּדְמוּת‎ i.e. one like the sons of man; similitude, resemblance Ezek 1:5, 10, 16, 22, 26; 10:10, 21, 22; אָדָם כְּמַרְאֵה דְּמוּת‎ 1:26; י ׳כְּבוֺד ד ׳מַרְאֵה‎ 1:28; also 2Kin 16:10 (pattern of altar), 2Chr 4:3 (images of oxen); of son in likeness of father Gen 5:3 (P); so also of man in likeness of God 1:26 (|| צֶלֶם‎) 5:1 (both P); compare Isa 40:18 what ׳ד‎ will ye compare to him (אֵל‎) ? || דִּמָּה‎ q. v.

2 adverbially, in likeness of, like as Isa 13:4 compare Ezek 23:15 & ׳כִּד‎ Psa 58:5. — Ezek 1:13 read וּבֵינוֺת‎, see בֵּין‎ and J P PetersJBL 1892 40. 42. On אֶחָד דְּמוּת‎ 1:16; 10:10 (apparently masculine) compare Thes & Sm who translate the likeness of one had they all four; Co reads אחת‎.

דמי.def:
H1824. domi

דֳּמִי‎ noun [masculine] cessation, pause, quiet, rest; ׳ד‎ Isa 62:6 2t.; construct דְּמִי‎ 38:10 (but see below); —

1 quiet, in phrase ׳אַלדֿ לָכֶם‎ Isa 62:6 keep not quiet (let there be no quiet to you); in prayer to God ׳אַלדֿ לָךְ‎ Psa 83:2 keep not quiet (inactive; || שׁקט חרשׂ,‎); compare ד ׳וְאַלתִּֿתְּנוּ לוֺ‎ Isa 62:7 and give no rest to him (׳י‎).

2 in phrase יָמַי בִּדְמִי‎, apparently quiet, peacefulness, even tenour, of my days (so De Or SS); others, as Hi Ew Che Di, pause, resting-time, i.e. noon-day (compare ᵑ9 ᵑ6‎, & height ᵐ5‎), figurative of middle life, but usage dubious; KloSK 1884, 157 cessation, pause, of natural end of life, Hezekiah's natural expectation, in, contrast with the speedy death implied in vb; but parallelism of Isa 62:11a is ag. this; Brd emends בְּרֻם‎ after ᵐ5‎; Klol.c. suggests בְּתֹם‎ or כְּתֹם‎ as possible, though not necessary; — but view stated first is on the whole best.

דמין.def:
H1825. dimyon

[דִּמְיֹן‎] noun [masculine] likeness, כְּאַרְיֵה דִּמְיֹנוֺ‎ Psa 17:12 his likeness is as a lion, i.e. he is like a lion.

דמם.def:
H1826. damam

I. [דָּמַם‎] verb be or grow dumb, silent, still (Late Hebrew id.; Ethiopic in II. stupefy; III., 1 & 2 be astounded, stupefied) —

Qal Perfect דַּ֫מּוּ‎ Job 30:27, דָּ֑מּוּ‎ Psa 35:15; Imperfect יִדֹּם‎ Amos 5:13 2t., וַיִּדֹּם‎ Lev 10:3; Josh 10:13; 3feminine singular תִּדֹּם‎ Lam 2:18; 2feminine singular תִּדֹּמִּי‎ Jer 48:2 (so Ki Ol & Kö327 q. v.; others Niph`al); וָאֶדֹּם‎ Job 31:34: יִדְּמוּ‎ Exod 15:16 3t.; 1 plural cohortative נִדְּמָה‎ Jer 8:14 (so Thes Ol Bö Kö327q. see; others Niph`al); —

1 be silent Psa 4:5; Psalm 30:13; 35:15 (probably, compare De Che), Ezek 24:17; Lev 10:3 (P) Amos 5:13; in grief Lam 2:10; 3:28.

2 be still (opposed to both speech and motion) Job 31:34; = perish Jer 8:14; 48:2; Psa 31:18 (׳ד לשׁאול‎); with לְ‎ be silent to i.e. be resigned to 37:7; 62:6, followed by עֲצָתִי לְמוֺ‎ Job 29:21 (|| שָֽׁמְעוּ לִי‎); be still, motionless, stand still Josh 10:12-13, (of sun || עמד‎); 1Sam 14:9 (men); Jer 47:6 (of sword || הֵרָֽגְעִי‎); so also of bowels, as seat of mental excitement Job 30:27; Lam 2:18 בַּתעֵֿינֵךְ אַלתִּֿדֹּם‎, i.e. cease not to weep (|| דִּמְעָה כַנַּחַל הוֺרִידִי‎).

3 be struck dumb, astounded, in amazement and fear Exod 15:16 (כאבן‎) Isa 23:2 (but compare II. דמם‎).

Niph`al Perfect3plural וְנָדַמּוּ‎ consecutive Jer 25:37; Imperfect יִדַּמּוּ‎ 49:26; 50:30, יִדָּ֑מּוּ‎ 1Sam 2:9; 2masculine plural תִּדַּמּוּ‎ Jer 51:6 — be made silent, i.e. destroyed; the wicked 1Sam 2:9 (בַּחשֶׁךְ‎), compare Jer 51:6; men of war 49:25; 50:30; dwellings 25:37.

Po. Perfect1singular נַפְשִׁי וְדוֺמַ֫מְתִּי שִׁוִּיתִי‎ Psa 131:2 'composed and quieted my soul Che (as a weaned child).

Hiph`il Perfect3masculine singular suffix הֲדִמָּנוּ‎ he (God) hath silenced us ( = caused to perish) Jer 8:14.

II. [דָּמַם‎] verb wail (?; compare Assyrian damâmu, groan, wail, lament, DlBaer's Ezech xi; pr 64) — only

Qal Imperative אִי ישְׁבֵי דֹּ֫מּוּ‎ Isa 23:2 wail, ye coast dwellers (compare Dll.c.), || הֵילִילוּ‎ 23:1, & אִי ישְׁבֵי הֵילִילוּ‎ 23:6; most, however, assign this to I.דמם‎ q. v. (3).

דמן‎ (√ of following, meaning dubious; Arabic , prepare, improve, manure land, apparently denominative)

דממה.def:
H1827. demamah

דְּמָמָה‎ noun feminine (silence) whisper (on formation compare BaNB 87) — דַקָּ֑ה דְּמָמָה קוֺל הָאֵשׁ וְאַחַר‎ 1Kin 19:12; אֶשְׁמָ֑ע זָקוֺל דְּמָמָה‎ Job 4:16 a whisper and a voice, i.e. an articulate whisper (compare Di); לִדְמָמָ֑ה סְעָרָה יָקֵם‎ Psa 107:29 he settleth storm into whisper.

דמן.def:
H1828. domen

דֹּ֫מֶן‎ noun masculine dung (Arabic ) always in this form and always of corpses, lying on ground as offal 2Kin 9:37; Jer 8:2; 9:21; 16:4; 25:33; Psa 83:11.

דמנה.def:
H1829. Dimnah

דִּמְנָה‎ proper name, of a location Levitical city in Zebulun Josh 21:35 (but read perhaps רִמֹּנָה‎ +; compare 1Chr 6:62; Josh 19:13, and see Di).

דמע.def:
H1830. dama

[דָּמַע‎] verb weep (Late Hebrew id., Arabic & ; Aramaic דְּמַע‎, : Assyrian in derivatives, see below),

Qal Imperfect3feminine singular, and Infinitive absolute, דִּמְעָה עֵינִי וְתֵרֵד תִּדְמַע וְדָמֹעַ‎ Jer 13:17.

דמעה.def:
H1832. dimah

דִּמְעָה‎ noun feminine collective tears (chiefly poetic and late; frequently in Jeremiah and contemporary) (Arabic ; Assyrian dimu, dimtu HptKAT 2 Gloss i. ZimBP 23, 95; Aramaic דִּמְעָא‎, ; Late Hebrew דִּמְעָה דֶּמַע,‎) — absolute ׳ד‎ Psa 80:6 10t.; construct דִּמְעַת‎ Eccl 4:1; suffix דִּמְעָתִי‎ Psa 6:7 4t.; דִּמְעָתֶ֑ךָ‎ 2Kin 20:5 = Isa 38:5 + Ezek 24:16 (strike out ᵐ5‎ Co); דִּמְעָתָהּ‎ Lam 1:2; plural דְּמָעוֺת‎ Psa 80:6; Lam 2:11 — tears Psa 6:7; Eccl 4:1; Lam 1:2; 2:11; especially in Jeremiah in phrase ד ׳עֵינִי תֵּרֵד‎ etc. Jer 9:17; 13:17; 14:17, compare Lam 2:18; Jeremiah 8:23 ד ׳מְקוֺר וְעֵינִי‎; דִּמְעָתִי אֲרַיָּ֫וֶךְ‎ of weeping over, in behalf of one Isa 16:9; as appealing to God's compassion 2Kin 20:5 = Isa 38:5; Psa 39:13; 56:9 בְּנאֹדֶ֑ךָ ד ׳שִׂימָה‎ (compare Che); see also 116:8; Jer 31:16; Isa 25:8; opposed to רִנָּה‎ Psa 126:5; of hypocritical tears Mal 2:13; figurative tears as food Psa 42:4 (לחם דִּמְעָתִי‎); ד ׳לחם‎ 80:6; as drink 80:6, compare Babylonian dimtu maštîtî, tears (were) my drink (ZimBP 42; || bikîtum kurmatî, weeping (was) my sustenance). — Ezek 24:16 דִּמְעָתֶ֑ךָ תָבוֺא וְלֹא‎ strike out ᵐ5‎ Co compare 24:23.

דמשק.def:
H1834. Dammeseq

דַּמֶּ֫שֶׂק‎ proper name, of a location Damascus (Assyrian Dimaš‡i, Dimas‡i, DlPa 280 SchrCOT Gen 15:2 & ABK 323 JägerBAS ii. 281 f. Arabic , ; Aramaic ᵑ7‎Onk, etc. דמשק‎, Ps-Jon דרמשק‎; ) — דַּמֶּשֶׂק‎ 1Kin 11:24 28t.; דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק‎ Gen 14:15 8t.; דַּרְמֶשֶׂק‎ 1Chr 18:5 3t. ch; דַּרְמָ֑שֶׂק‎2Chr 24:23; 28:5; דּוּמֶּשֶׂק‎ 2Kin 16:10; דְּמֶשֶׁק‎ Amos 3:12 see following, Vrss. דַּמֶּשֶׂק‎; — ancient Aramaean city, situated latitude 33 degrees 30 minutes north, longitude 36 degrees 15 minutes east, in plain east of Hermon & southeast of Anti-Lebanon; on the Nahr Baradâ (Greek Chrysorrhoas); modern Dimish‡ & Esh-Sham, RobBR iii. 440 ff. BdPal 307; Damascus Gen 14:15; Amos 5:27; 1Kin 11:24 (twice in verse); 2Kin 14:28; Song 7:5; so also probably Gen 15:2 (perhaps gloss compare Di), (Amos 3:12 see following); a trading-centre Ezek 27:18; as capital & residence of king of Aram 1Kin 15:18 2Chr 16:2, compare 1Kin 20:34; 2Kin 16:9-10, (twice in verse); 16:11 (twice in verse); 16:12; 2Chr 28:5; Isa 7:8 (twice in verse); 8:4; 10:9 (compare PetersHebraica. April 1885, 242) 17:1 (twice in verse); 17:3; Jer 49:23-24, 27; including also surrounding territory Ezek 47:16-17, compare 47:18; 48:1, see ד ׳מִדְבַּ֫רָה‎ 1Kin 19:15; ד ׳נַהֲרוֺת‎ 2Kin 5:12; = kingdom Amos 1:3, 5 compare Zech 9:1; once (late) ד ׳מֶלֶךְ‎2Chr 24:23; note also ד ׳אֲרַם‎ 2Sam 8:5-6, = 1Chr 18:5-6, further ד ׳אֱלֹהֵי‎2Chr 28:23 (|| אֲרָם מַלְכֵי אֱלֹהֵי‎).

דן.def:
H1835. Dan

דָּן‎ proper name, masculine (judge) —

1 son of Jacob and Bilhah Gen 30:6; 35:25; Exod 1:4; Josh 19:47; Judg 18:29; 1Chr 2:2.

2 the tribe of Dan, דָן מַטֵּה‎ Exod 31:6; 35:34; 38:23; Lev 24:11; Num 1:39; 13:12; Josh 21:5, 23 (all P); דָן בְּנֵי‎ Gen 46:23; Num 1:38; 2:25; 7:66; 10:25; 26:42; 34:22; Josh 19:40, 47 (twice in verse); 19:48 (all P) Judg 1:34; 18:2, 16, 22, 23, 25, 26, 30; דָן מַחֲנֵה‎ Num 2:25, 31 (P) — on Judg 13:25; 18:12 see מַחֲנֶה‎; דָּן מִשְׁמְּחֹת‎ Num 26:42 (P); דָּן‎ alone in poetry Gen 49:16-17, Deut 33:22 (twice in verse); Judg 5:17, elsewhere Num 1:12 (P) Deut 27:13; 1Chr 27:22; 2Chr 2:13; Ezek 48:1-2, 32.

3 a city on northern frontier of Israel at one of the sources of the Jordan, originally לַיִשׁ‎ Judg 18:29 (compare 18:7); = לֶשֶׁם‎ Josh 19:47; captured by a colony of Danites; named Dan, and made a sacred place with rites of worship that lasted until the exile (Judg 18:30); = Tell el Kâdî, RobBR iii. 351, 358 BdPa1 265. This place is frequently referred to: Gen 14:14; Deut 34:1; 1Kin 12:29-30, 15:20; 2Kin 10:29; 2Chr 16:4; Jer 4:15; 8:16; Amos 8:14; read also וּבְדָן‎ for וְכֵן‎ 2Sam 20:18 ᵐ5‎ Ew We compare Dr; and see the phrase שֶׁבַע וְעַדבְּֿאֵר מִדָּן‎ Judg 20:1; 1Sam 3:20; 2Sam 3:10; 17:11; 24:2, 15; 1Kin 5:5; given by Chronicles וְעַדדָּֿן שֶׁבַע מִבְּאֵר‎ 1Chr 21:2; 2Chr 30:5. (Ezek 27:19 see ודן‎.)

Note. — יַעַן דָּ֫נָה‎ 2Sam 24:6. As no such place is known, the text is usually regarded as corrupt, and, ᵐ5‎ being uncertain, is variously changed: (1) יַעַר דָּ֫נָה‎ to Dan in the wood, Thes after ᵑ9‎ silvestria. (2) (וַיָּסֹבּוּ‎) וְעִיּוֺן דָּ֫נָה‎ to Dan and Ijon Klo (compare 1Kin 15:20). (3) (סָֽבֲבוּ‎) וּמִדָּן דָּן‎ We Dr compare ᵐ5‎.

דנה.def:
H1836. denah

דְּנָה‎57 demonstrative prounoun common this (Zinjirli זנה זן,‎; Egyptian Aramaic זנה‎ (S-C Pap. B 17 +); זנך‎ (ib.C 6, D 8); Nabataean, Palmyrene דנה‎ (Lzb264 Cooke26); דֵּין ᵑ7‎ (e.g. 1Sam 10:27) and (with הָ‎, i.e. הָא‎, ecce) הָדֵתן‎; Aramaic of Têma זא הא‎ (Cooke195. 198); Syriac (contracted for הָֽדְנָא‎); Mandean האזין‎; Sabean (HomChrest. 13); Ethiopic all from [דֶּה‎,] זה‎, + demonstrative noun (WCG 108 f.); feminine Biblical Aramaic הָדה דָּא, ᵑ7 דָּא,‎, Syriac , Mandean האזא‎, Ethiopic without the n; the plural is אִלֵּין‎, q. v. ); — this:

a. Dan 2:18 דְנָה רָזָא‎ this secret, 2:28; 2:29; 2:30 +, Ezra 4:11; 5:3-4, 9 +; כָּלדְּֿנָה‎ Dan 5:22.

b. דְנָה אַחֲרֵי‎ after this Dan 2:29, 45; so דְּנָה בָּאתַר‎ 7:6-7,.

c. כִּדְנָה‎ like this, thus, Jer 10:10 (= Hebrew כֹּה‎), Dan 2:10 כִדְנָה מִלְּתָא‎ a word like this (compare כָּזֹאת‎ Est 4:14), Esther 3:29; Ezra 5:7.

d. עַלדְּֿנָה‎ on account of this Dan 3:16; Ezra 4:22; 5:5, 17; 6:11; as conjunction = therefore (compare Hebrew עַלזֹֿאת‎) 4:14-15,. — See also קֳבֵלַ‎ and קַדְמָה‎.

דנהבה.def:
H1838. Dinhabah

דִּנְהָ֑בָה‎ proper name, of a location capital city of king Bela in Edom Gen 36:32 = 1Chr 1:43; identification with Tennib (perhaps = Thenib, near the edge of the Belka, east-northeast from Heshbon, described by TristrMoab 222) by NeubauerAcad. 1891, 260 compare Tomkinsib. 284.

דָּנִיֵּאל‎ see דָּנִאֵל‎ below דין‎.

דֵּעָה דֵּעַ,‎ see below ידע‎.

דְּעוּאֵל (רְעוּאֵל)‎ see below רעה ידע,‎.

דני.def:
H1839. Dani

דָּנִי‎ adjective, of a people always with article as proper name collective הַדָּנִי‎ 1Chr 12:35; הַדָּנִי שֵׁבֶט‎ Judg 18:1, 30; הַדָּנִי מִשְׁמַּחַת‎ 13:2; 18:11.

דניאל.def:
H1840. Daniyyel

or Daniel דָּנִאֵל‎, later דָּנִיֵּאל‎ proper name, masculine (compare Ew§ 45 d; El is my judge; on a possible connection with Zend dânu, wise, or wisdom compare CheOP 107; see Palmyrene דנאל‎ Vog93) —

1 son of David 1Chr 3:1, דָּנִיֵּאל‎, but dub, compare CheOP 106; ᵐ5‎ Δαμνιηλ, ᵐ5‎L & Manuscripts Δαλουια; || 2Sam 3:3 ᵐ5 כִּלְאָב,‎ Δαλουια; KloSm proposes דֹּדִיָּה‎, & in Chronicles דֹּדִיאֵל‎, but grounds precarious.

2 דָּנִיֵּאל‎, priest of the line of Ithamar Ezra 8:2; Neh 10:7.

3 דָּנִאֵל‎ a great sage Ezek 28:3; classed with Noah and Job as models of righteousness 14:14, 20; perhaps the same as

4 דָּנִיֵּאל‎, one of the noble young men taken into captivity by Nebuchadrezzar according to Dan 1:1-6, the hero of the book of Daniel, 1:6 22t. (also frequently in Aramaic section).

דע.def:
H1843. dea

[דֵּעַ‎] noun [masculine] knowledge, opinion (late) — only suffix דֵּעִי‎ Job 32:6 3t., and plural דֵּעִים‎ 37:6; all in speech of Elihu.

1 knowledge, ד ׳תְּמִים‎ Job 37:16 one perfect in knowledge (of God).

2 judgement, opinion Job 36:3; דֵּעִי חַֹוּת‎ 32:6 to declare my opinion, so 32:10; 32:17.

דעה.def:
H1844. deah

דֵּעָה‎ noun feminine knowledge (strictly Infinitive of ידע‎) — דֵּעָה‎ Psa 73:11 3t.; plural דֵּעוֺת‎ 1Sam 2:3; Job 36:4; — ד ׳תְּמִים‎ 36:4 (of Elihu); of God's knowledge, ד ׳אֵל ׳י‎ 1Sam 2:3 a God of knowledge is ׳י‎ (on plural see Dr); בְעֶלְיוֺן דֵּעָה יֵשׁ‎ Psa 73:11 (|| יָדַעאֵֿל אֵיכָה‎); knowledge, with ׳י‎ as object Isa 11:9 (where verbal force of noun appears); as taught by prophets 28:9; וְהַשְׂכֵּיל דֵּעָה אֶתְכֶם וְרָעוּ‎ Jer 3:15 of ׳י‎s shepherds (i.e. future ideal rulers). Gr proposes (plausibly) רָעֹה‎, after ᵐ5‎, see also Gie.

דעואל.def:
H1845. Deuel

דְּעוּאֵל‎ proper name, masculine a Gadite, Num 1:14; 7:42, 47; 10:20, but ᵐ5‎ in all Παγουηλ, so ᵑ6 ⅏‎; = רְעוּאֵל‎ 2:14, where, however, ᵑ9‎ and Hebrew Manuscripts ׳ד‎ (all P); see further below רעה‎. p. 944 ff

דעך.def:
H1846. daak

[דָּעַךְ‎] verb go out, be extinguished (in poetry & especially Wisdom literature) (Aramaic דְּעִיךְ‎, ) —

Qal Perfect3masculine plural דָּֽעֲכוּ‎ Isa 43:17; Imperfect יִדְעַךְ‎ Prov 20:20, יִדְעָ֑ךְ‎ Job 18:5 4t.; — go out, be extinguished, of lamp, always figurative, lamp of wicked (i.e. prosperity) רְשָׁעִים אוֺר‎ 18:5, ר ׳נֵר‎ 18:6; 21:17; Prov 13:9; 20:20; 24:20; of hostile armies Isa 43:17 (|| כָּב֫וּ‎).

Niph`al Perfect3plural נִדְעֲכוּ‎ be made extinct, dried up, Job 6:17 (of brooks).

Pu`al Perfect3plural דֹּעֲכוּ‎ of assailants, be extinguished, quenched, קוֺצִים כְּאֵשׁ‎ Psa 118:12; but read perhaps בערו‎ with ᵐ5‎ Bae & Che, see Checritical note.

דַּעַת‎ see below ידע‎.

דעת.def:

דַּ֫עַת‎ noun femininePsa 139:6 Dan 12:4 (masculine Prov 2:10; 14:6, possibly Job 33:3 Ew§174 g) knowledge (properly Infinitive, which appears clearly Gen 2:9, 17; Jer 22:16) — absolute דַּ֫עַת‎ Gen 2:9 35t.; דָּ֑עַת‎ Josh 20:3 35t.; construct דַּ֫עַת‎ Num 24:16 10t.; suffix דַּעְתִּי‎ Prov 22:17; דַּעְתְּךָ‎ Job 10:7; דַּעְתֵּךְ‎ Isa 47:10; דַּעְתּוֺ‎ Prov 3:20; Isa 53:11; דַּעְתְּכֶם‎ Job 13:2; דַּעְתָּם‎ Isa 44:25; —

1. a. knowledge, perception in phrase ד ׳בִּבְלִי‎ Deut 4:42 = unintenionally, 19:4; Josh 20:3 (where P's synonym is בִּשְׁגָגָה‎ 20:3; 20:9, compare Num 35:11, 15), 35:5; without knowing ד ׳מִבְּלִי‎ Isa 5:13 ( = before they knew it, suddenly).

b. = skill (in work-manship) Exod 31:3; 35:31 (both P; both || תְּבוּנָה‎ and חָכְמָה‎), 1Kin 7:14 (followed by infinitive); creative skill Isa 40:14 (|| תְּבוּנוֺת דֶּרֶךְ מִשְׁמָּט, אֹרַח‎).

c. of prophetic knowledge ד ׳יֹדֵעַ עליון‎ Num 24:16 (JE), compare Psa 19:3.

d. especially knowledge with moral quality Gen 2:9, 17 (J; in both verbal force, ׳הַדּ וָרַע טוֺב‎ the knowing good and evil).

e. knowledge possessed by God Job 10:7; Psa 139:6; Prov 3:20 (|| חָכְמָה‎ and תְּבוּנָה‎), 21:12; taught by God to men Psa 94:10; 119:66 (|| טַעַם טוּב‎), Prov 2:6 (|| תְּבוּנָה‎ and חָכְמָה‎). feminine דַּעַתרֿוּחַ‎ = windy (unreal) knowledge Job 15:2.

2 especially in Wisdom Literature = discernment, understanding, wisdom:

a. Job 13:2; 33:3 (׳ד שְׂפָתַי‎), בְּדַעַת לֹא‎ 34:35(|| חכמה‎), Prov 8:9-10, (|| מוסר‎), 10:4; 11:9; 18:15 (twice in verse); 22:12; 29:7, compare Isa 32:4; 53:11; Jer 10:14 = 51:17; דעת בבלי‎ Job 35:16; 36:12; ד ׳בלי‎ 38:2; 42:3, ד ׳בְּלֹא‎ Prov 19:2; || תְּבוּנָה‎ 17:27; Isa 44:19; ׳ת‎ + חכמה‎ Prov 24:4, || מְזִמָּה‎ 1:4; 5:2; ׳ד מְזִמּוֺת‎ 8:12; || verb עָרַם‎ 19:25; || מֹצֵעוֺת‎ 22:20; || מוּסָר‎ 12:1; 19:27; 23:12; || תּוֺרָה‎ Mal 2:7; || חכמה‎ Prov 14:6; Eccl 1:16, 18; 2:21, 26; 7:12; 9:10: connected with חָכָם‎ Prov 21:11; Eccl 12:9; חכמים דברי‎ Prov 22:17; Isa 33:6 (חכמת‎) 44:25 (חכמים‎); wisdom of magicians 47:10; Dan 1:4 (|| חָכְמָה‎ and מַדָּע‎).

b. in highest sense, knowledge of God (including obedience) Hosea 4:1, 6 (הַדַּעַת מִבְּלִי‎), 4:6; 6:6; Job 21:14; Prov 2:5 (|| י ׳יראת‎), so Isa 11:2; 58:2; Jer 22:16 (verbal force, with accusative), Prov 9:10 (׳ד קדשׁים‎, || י ׳יראת‎), 30:3 (id., || חָכְמָה‎); see also י ׳יִרְאַת ד ׳ראשׁית‎ 1:7 (|| מוּסָר חָכְמָה‎), 1:22; 1:29 (|| י ׳יִרְאַת‎) 2:10 (|| חָכְמָה‎).

c. opposed to אִוֶּלֶת‎ Prov 12:23; 13:16; 14:18; 15:2 compare 15:7, also 15:14.

d. ׳שִׂפְתֵידֿ‎ Prov 14:7; 20:15; ד ׳אישׁ‎ 24:5 (|| חָכָם גֶּבֶר‎). — Dan 12:4 is dubious; ᵐ5‎ Bev read הָרָעֹת ותרכה‎.

שֶׁ֫מֶן‎192 noun masculine 2Kin 20:13 (on apparently feminine Song 1:3 compare AlbrZAW xvi (1896), 99, 106) fat, oil; — ׳שׁ‎ absolute Genesis 28:28 +, construct Lev 8:2 +; ׳שָׁ֑‎ 2Kin 4:6 +; suffix שַׁמְנִי‎ Hosea 2:7 +, etc.; plural שְׁמָנִים‎ Amos 6:6 +; suffix שְׁמָנֶיךָ‎ Song 1:3, נַיִח‎- 4:10; —

1 fat, fatness: בֶּןשֿׁ ׳קֶרֶן‎ Isa 5:1 (of fertile slope); plural גֵּיאשְֿׁמָנִים‎ 28:1, 4; of food (in figurative) 25:6 (twice in verse); literal מִשָּׁ֑מֶן כָּחַשׁ כְּשָׂרִי‎ Psa 109:24 (compare צוֺם‎ va), compare שׁ ׳מִמְּנֵי‎ Isa 10:27 (in figurative, si vera lectio, meaning obscure; most now emend by conjecture; RSJPH xili (1885), 62 שֹׁרֵד מִצָּפוֺן עָלָה‎ [see also II. חבל‎], joining to 10:28; Du Marti has gone up from Pene-Rimmon [??], compare Di-Kit).

2. a. oil, specifically olive-oil, as rich product Deut 8:8 + (see זַיִת‎); hence שׁ ׳עֵץ‎ Isa 41:19 oil-tree, usually explained as wild olive, oleaster, so Neh 8:15 (|| וַיִת‎), שׁ ׳עֲצֵי‎ oleaster-wood 1Kin 6:23, 31, 32, 33; once ׳שׁ הַמֹּר‎ Est 2:2 (see מֹר‎ p. 600:b; ׳מ‎ also in holy anointing oil Exod 30:23).

b. ׳שׁ‎ as staple (codiment) Num 11:8 (J; see לשׁד‎), of value 1Kin 17:12, 14, 16; 2Kin 2:4, 6, 7 4t.; symbol of plenty Deut 32:13; 33:24; Job 29:6; ascribed (fassely) to gift of Baals Hosea 2:7; as royal treasure 2Kin 20:13 = Isa 39:2, compare 1 Kings 5:25 (׳שׁ תִית כָּ‎, see ׳כ‎) = 2Chr 2:9; 2:14 3t.; tribute Hosea 12:2, article of trade Ezek 27:17; odoriferous Prov 27:9; Song 1:3; 4:10, ׳שׁ רוֺקֵחַ‎ Eccl 10:1, so (figurative) Song 1:3; Eccl 7:1; Prov 27:16 is corrupt, see Toy; sign of luxury Ezek 16:13; Prov 21:17, of prosperity Ezek 16:20.

c. ׳שׁ‎ as medicament Isa 1:6; as unguent, for shield 2Sam 1:21, person Amos 6:6; Micah 6:15; Deut 28:40; Ezek 16:9; Esther; Psa 92:11; 104:15, not for mourner 2Sam 14:2; on head token of happiness Eccl 9:8, of hospitality, בַּמֹּ ׳דִּמַּנְתָּ ראֹשִׁי‎ Psa 23:5 (figurative), in simile 133:2; 141:5.

d. for anointing king, הַשּׂ ׳מַּח‎ 1Sam 10:1; 2Kin 9:1, 3, compare 9:6, with קֶרֶן‎ 1Sam 16:1, 13; 1Kin 1:39; compare ׳בְּשׁ מְשַׁחְתִּיו קָדְשִׁי‎ Psa 89:21.

e. in various figs., of joy ׳שׁ שָׂשׂוֺן‎ Isa 61:3; Psa 45:8; soft words 55:22; Prov 5:3; as penetrating Prov 109:18; as clear, transparent Ezek 32:14.

f. used in primitive worship, poured on stone Gen 28:18 (E), 35:14 (J).

g. in later ritual: for anointing priests, tabernacle, altar utensils, etc. (P), made of various ingred., ׳שׁ וַיִת‎ among them, Exod 30:24, ׳שׁ הַמִּשְׁתָה‎ 25:6; Lev 8:2, 10, 12 11t.; ׳שׁ מִשְׁחַתקֹֿדֶשׁ‎ Exod 30:25 (twice in verse) + 2t.; ׳שׁ ׳מ ׳י‎ Lev 10:7, ׳שׁ ׳מ אֱםהָיו‎ 21:12; ׳שׁ ׳הקּ‎ Num 35:25; ׳שׁ‎ alone Lev 14:10 12t. Leviticus 14; for lighting Exod 25:6 6t. + ׳שׁ חִית כָּ זָח זַיִת‎ 27:20; Lev 24:2 (see תִית כָּ‎); poured upon מִנְחָה‎ 2:1 5t., compare 5:11; Num 5:15; smeared (see מָשַׁח‎) upon wafers Exod 29:2; Lev 2:4 +, and cakes (or mixed in the making? compare בָּלַל‎) Exod 29:2; Lev 2:4-5, +, so בַּשׁ ׳סֹלֶת‎ 2:7 etc. (c. 45 t. in all), שׁ לֶחֶם ׳חַלַּת‎ Exod 29:23; Lev 8:26.

h. for use in temple 1Chr 9:29.

i. for תְּרוּמָה‎ in Ezekiel's temple Ezek 45:14 (twice in verse) + 7 t. 45, 46.

j. efficacy denied Micah 6:7

k. offered to idols Isa 57:9; Ezek 16:18-19, 23:41. — See MacalisterHast. DB OIL ARSKEncy. Bib. OIL.

1 tread, march, march forth, absolute, עֹז נַפְשִׁי תִּדְרְכִי‎ Judg 5:21; compare מִיַּעֲקֹב כּוֺכָב דָּרַךְ‎ Num 24:17 (poem) a star hath marched forth from Jacob.

Once followed by accusative (אֲשֶׁר‎ reference אֹרַח‎) Job 22:15. In technical senses

3 tread wine- (or oil-) press, followed by accusative יְקָבִים‎ Job 24:11 (|| יַצְהִירוּ‎), גִּתּוֺת‎ Neh 13:15; followed by accusative of thing pressed ׳ד עֲנָבִים‎ Amos 9:13; also of product וְתִירוֺשׁ ֗֗֗ תִּדְרֹךְזַֿיִת‎ Micah 6:15; הַדֹּרֵךְ יִדְרֹךְ לֹא בַּיְקָבִים יַיִן‎ Isa 16:10; followed by בְּגַת‎ 63:2 (in simile); absolute Jer 25:30 (simile) 48:33; figurative of judgment Isa 63:3 followed by accusative מּוּרָה‎ winepress, subject ׳י‎, compare 63:3 בְּאַמִּי וְאֶדְרְכֵם‎ (|| רמס‎), i.e. tread them down; so בַּתיְֿהוּדָה לִבְתוּלַת אֲדֹנָי דָּרַךְ גַּת‎Lam 1:15.

4 tread (i.e. bend) the bow, followed by accusative קֶשֶׁת‎ Jer 51:8 (קַשְׁתּוֺ הַדֹּרֵךְ יד֯רך אֶליִֿדְרֹךְ‎); figurative of assaults of wicked Psa 11:2; 37:14, of judgments of ׳י‎ Psalm 7:18; Lam 2:4; 3:12; also figurative of Judah as bow in hand of יְהוּדָה לִי דָרַכְתִּי כִּי ׳י,‎ Zech 9:13 (|| אֶפְרַיִם מִלֵּאתִי קֶשֶׁת‎); twice in like meaning with object חֵץ‎ arrow Psa 58:8 (but on text compare Checritical note.) 64:4; קֶשֶׁת דֹּרְכֵי‎ = bow-benders, archers Jer 50:14, 29; 1Chr 5:18; 8:40; 2Chr 14:7; דְּרוּכָה קֶשֶׁת‎ bent bow Isa 21:15; דְּרֻכוֺת קַשְׁתֹֿתָיו‎ 5:28.

Hiph`il Perfect וְהִדְרִיךְ‎ Isa 11:15; suffix הִדְרִיכָהּ‎ Jer 51:33 (where many Infinitive construct) compare RSJ Ph xvi. (1888) 72; 1 singular suffix הִדְרַכְתִּיךָ‎ Prov 4:11; 3plural suffix הִדְרִיכֻ֑הוּ‎ Judg 20:43, הִדְרִיכוּהוּ‎ Job 28:8; Imperfect יַדְרֵךְ‎ Psa 25:9, suffix יַדְרִכֵנִי‎ Hab 3:19; וַיַּדְרִיכֵם‎ Psa 107:7; 1singular suffix אַדְרִיכֵם‎ Isa 42:16; וַיַּדְרְכוּ‎ Jer 9:2 (compare Ges§ 53, 3, R 4); Imperative masculine singular suffix הַדְרִיכֵנִי‎ Psa 25:5; 119:35; Infinitive construct see above; Participle suffix מַדְרִיכְךָ‎ Isa 48:17; —

1 tread, tread down, of treading down enemy in battle Judg 20:43; of treading a path Job 28:8; levelling threshing-floor Jer 51:33 (all followed by suffix).

2 tread (bend) the bow (= Qal 4), only figurative שֶׁקֶר קַשְׁתָּם אֶתלְֿשׁוֺנָם וַיַּדְרְכוּ‎ Jer 9:2 and they have bent their tongue as their bow in falsehood.

3 causative, cause to tread or march, lead, returning exiles Isa 11:15 (subject ׳י‎; no object expressed); compare יְשָׁרָה בְּדֶרֶךְ וַיַּדְרִיכֵם‎ Psa 107:7 and he led them in a straight way; see also Isa 42:16 (|| הוֺלִיךְ‎); with a moral application בְּמַעְגְּלֵייֿשֶׁר הִדְרַכְתִּיךָ‎ Prov 4:11; compare Psa 119:35 מִצְוֺתֶיךָ בִּנְתִיב הַדְרִיכֵנִי‎ lead me in the path of thy commandments; 25:5 בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ‎ || (לַמְּדֵנִיׅ‎ compare 25:9 בַּמִּשְׁמָּט דַּרְכּוֺ) יְלַמֵּד‎, Isa 48:17 תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ‎ || מְלַמֶּדְךָׅ (לְהוֺעִל‎; once of giving security & triumph יַדְרִכֵנִי עַלבָּֿמוֺתַי‎ Hab 3:19 upon mine heights he maketh me tread (compare Qal 2).

דַּמֶּ֫שֶׂק‎ proper name, of a location Damascus (Assyrian Dimaš‡i, Dimas‡i, DlPa 280 SchrCOT Gen 15:2 & ABK 323 JägerBAS ii. 281 f. Arabic , ; Aramaic ᵑ7‎Onk, etc. דמשק‎, Ps-Jon דרמשק‎; ) — דַּמֶּשֶׂק‎ 1Kin 11:24 28t.; דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק‎ Gen 14:15 8t.; דַּרְמֶשֶׂק‎ 1Chr 18:5 3t. ch; דַּרְמָ֑שֶׂק‎2Chr 24:23; 28:5; דּוּמֶּשֶׂק‎ 2Kin 16:10; דְּמֶשֶׁק‎ Amos 3:12 see following, Vrss. דַּמֶּשֶׂק‎; — ancient Aramaean city, situated latitude 33 degrees 30 minutes north, longitude 36 degrees 15 minutes east, in plain east of Hermon & southeast of Anti-Lebanon; on the Nahr Baradâ (Greek Chrysorrhoas); modern Dimish‡ & Esh-Sham, RobBR iii. 440 ff. BdPal 307; Damascus Gen 14:15; Amos 5:27; 1Kin 11:24 (twice in verse); 2Kin 14:28; Song 7:5; so also probably Gen 15:2 (perhaps gloss compare Di), (Amos 3:12 see following); a trading-centre Ezek 27:18; as capital & residence of king of Aram 1Kin 15:18 2Chr 16:2, compare 1Kin 20:34; 2Kin 16:9-10, (twice in verse); 16:11 (twice in verse); 16:12; 2Chr 28:5; Isa 7:8 (twice in verse); 8:4; 10:9 (compare PetersHebraica. April 1885, 242) 17:1 (twice in verse); 17:3; Jer 49:23-24, 27; including also surrounding territory Ezek 47:16-17, compare 47:18; 48:1, see ד ׳מִדְבַּ֫רָה‎ 1Kin 19:15; ד ׳נַהֲרוֺת‎ 2Kin 5:12; = kingdom Amos 1:3, 5 compare Zech 9:1; once (late) ד ׳מֶלֶךְ‎2Chr 24:23; note also ד ׳אֲרַם‎ 2Sam 8:5-6, = 1Chr 18:5-6, further ד ׳אֱלֹהֵי‎2Chr 28:23 (|| אֲרָם מַלְכֵי אֱלֹהֵי‎).

דַּרְיוֺשׁ‎ Ezra 10:16 see דרשׁ‎.

דָּרַשׁ‎162 verb resort to, seek (compare Arabic rub over, efface (a site), tread (wheat), figurative read repeatedly, study; beat (a path), discuss, Pa`el practise in; Late Hebrew search out (a meaning), expound) —

Qal Perfect 1Chr 10:14; Imperfect יִדְרשׁ‎ Psa 10:4 +, אֶדְרְשָׁה‎ 1Sam 28:7, נִדְרְשָׁה‎ 1Kin 22:7 +, יִדְרְשׁוּן‎ Isa 55:2; Imperative דְּרָשֿׁ‎ 1Kin 22:5 +; Infinitive absolute דָּרשׁ‎ Lev 10:16; Deut 23:22; construct דְּרשׁ‎ 22:2 + לִדְרָשֿׁ‎ Ezek 14:7, לְדַרְיוֺשׁ‎ (scribal error for לִדְרוֺשׁ‎ Ew§ 239a Ol§ 245 g) Ezra 10:16; Participle דֹּרֵשׁ‎ Deut 11:12 10t., דּוֺרֵשׁ‎ 1Chr 28:9 3t.; passive דְּרוּשִׁים‎ Psa 111:2, דְּרוּשָׁה‎ Isa 62:12; synonym בקשׁ‎; —

1 (tread a place,) resort to, frequent, with religious object, with accusative of location Amos 5:5; 2Chr 1:5, לְ‎ local Deut 12:5.

2 seek, consult, inquire of:

a. accusative אֱלֹהִים ׳י,‎ Gen 25:22 (J) Exod 18:15 (E) 1Sam 9:9; 1Kin 22:8; 2Kin 3:11; 8:8; 22:13, 18; 1Chr 15:13; 21:30; 2Chr 18:7; 34:21; Psa 24:6; 78:34; Jer 21:2; 37:7; Ezek 20:1, 3; the ark of God 1Chr 13:3; word of Yahweh 1Kin 22:5 (= 2Chr 18:4) compare 1Kin 14:5; with בְּ‎ Yahweh 1Chr 10:14; 2Chr 34:26; Ezek 14:7; his word 2Kin 1:16; with אֶלאֵֿל אֶל,‎ Job 5:8; their God Isa 8:19, Messianic king 11:10; י ׳מֵעַלסֵֿפֶר‎ out of the book of ׳י‎ 34:16 (in gloss, according to CheJQ Jan. 1892, 332); with מֵאוֺתוֺ‎ of a לי ׳נָבִיא‎ 1Kin 22:7 (= 2Chr 18:6) compare (above) 18:8; 2Kin 3:11 and 1Kin 14:5 (מֵעִמְּךָ‎).

b. heathen gods and necromancers, הַדֹּרֵשׁ‎ the inquirer Ezek 14:10; with אוֺב בַּעֲלַת בְּ,‎ 1Sam 28:7, בָּאוֺב‎ 1Chr 10:13, זְבוּב בְּבַעַל‎ 2Kin 1:2-3, 6, 16; with אֶלהָֿאֹבוֺת אֶל,‎ Isa 8:19, אֶלהַֿמֵּתִים‎ Deut 18:11, אֶלהָֿאֱלִילִים‎ Isa 19:3.

3 seek deity in prayer and worship:

a. the true God (compare בקשׁ‎ 3) י ׳דרשׁ‎ Deut 4:29; Hosea 10:12; Amos 5:4, 6; Isa 9:12; 31:1; 55:6; 58:2; 65:10; Jer 10:21; 29:13; Zeph 1:6; Lam 3:25; 1Chr 16:11 (= Psa 105:4) 28:9; 2Chr 12:14; 14:3; 14:6; 15:2, 12; 16:12; 22:9; 26:5; Psa 9:11; 22:27; 34:5; 34:11; 119:2; 119:10; (ה)אלהים דרשׁ‎2Chr 19:3; 26:5; 30:19; Psa 14:2 (= 53:3) 69:33; ד ׳אֲדֹנָי‎ 77:3; with לְ‎, only in Chronicler, ליהוה‎ 1Chr 22:19; 2Chr 15:13; 20:3; Ezra 6:21; לאלהים‎2Chr 17:4; 31:21; 34:3; Ezra 4:2; DrIntr. 503 finds in Chronicles weakened meaning, revere.

b. seek heathen deities, with accusative Jer 8:2; 2Chr 25:15, 20; with לְ‎, Deut 12:30; 2Chr 17:3.

4. a. seek, with idea of demanding, require (בקשׁ‎ is seek, simply), with accusative lost sheep Deut 22:2; Ezek 34:6, 8, 11; goat Lev 10:16 (twice in verse) (P); with אחר‎, after green fodder Job 39:8.

b. inquire, investigate (a matter), absolute Judg 6:29; Deut 13:15; 17:4, 9; 19:18; with accusative י ׳דּוֺרֵשׁ כָּללְֿבָבוֺת‎ all hearts Yahweh searches 1Chr 28:9; הַמּוֺפֵת לִדְרשׁ‎ to inquire into the wonder2Chr 32:31; with לְ‎, to inquire about 2Sam 11:3; Job 10:6; followed by עַל‎ person + infinitive 2Chr 24:6 apply to the Levites to bring, etc., compare 31:9 (עַל‎ both person and thing).

5 ask for, require, demand, with accusative of thing Ezek 20:40; + מִן‎ person Deut 23:22; Micah 6:8; exact, often with collateral idea of avenging, מֵעִם‎ Deut 18:19, so with מִיַּד‎ Ezek 34:10, מִיַּד דָּם דָּרַשׁ‎ Gen 9:5 (P) Ezek 33:6; accusative only, דמים דֹּרֵשׁ‎ Psa 9:13, ׳ד רִשְׁעוֺ‎ 10:15; absolute 10:4; 10:13; 2Chr 24:22.

6 seek with application, study, follow, practise, absolute by wisdom Eccl 1:13; with accusative ׳ד מִשְׁמָּט‎ study or practise justice Isa 1:17; 16:5; י ׳מַעֲשֵׂי‎ Psa 111:2; וְאַלרַֿע טוֺב‎ Amos 5:14; commands of God Psa 119:45; 119:94; 119:155; 1Chr 28:8; the law Ear 7:10; ׳ד שׁלום‎ seek or study the peace, welfare of any one Deut 23:7; Jer 29:7; Ezra 9:12, לשׁלום‎ Jer 38:4, ׳ד טוב‎ Est 10:3, ׳ד רעה‎ Prov 11:27; Psa 38:13 (compare בקשׁ‎ 2, where this use is more common).

7 seek with care, care for, אתהּ דֹּרֵשׁ אלהיך יהוה אשׁר ארץ‎ land which Yahweh thy God careth for Deut 11:12; אֱלוֺהַּ אַליִֿדְרְשֵׁהוּ‎ let not Eloah care for it Job 3:4; יִד לֹא ׳אוֺתָךְ‎ Jer 30:14; צֶמֶר דָּֽרְשָׁה‎ Prov 31:13; with לְ‎ Jer 30:17; לְנַפְשִׁי דּוֺרֵשׁ אֵין‎ no one careth for me Psa 142:5; but in both these לְ‎ perhaps belongs to אֵין‎, compare || מַכִּיר לִי אֵין‎ 142:5, also Lam 4:4 etc.; דְּרוּשָׁה‎ cared for (of Jerusalem) Isa 62:12.

Niph`al Perfect נִדְרָ֑שׁ‎ Gen 42:22, נִדְרַשְׁתִּי‎ Isa 65:1, נִדְרָ֑שׁוּ‎ 1Chr 26:31; Imperfect אִדָּרֵשׁ‎ Ezek 14:3; 20:3, 31, 31; 36:37; Infinitive absolute הַאִדָּרשׁ‎ 14:3 (for ההדרשׁ‎); —

1 let oneself be inquired of, consulted, only of God Ezek 14:3 (twice in verse); 20:3, 31, 31; 36:37; Isa 65:1.

2 be sought out 1Chr 26:31.

3 be required, of blood (compare Qal 5) Gen 42:22 (E).

Note. — מֵחָרְבוֺתֵיהֶם וְדָרְשׁוּ‎ and beg out of their desolate places Psa 109:10 (Ki and others wed©ršu, see Baer); many MSS. read דָּֽרְשׁוּ‎, so most interpretations; ᵐ5‎ Hup Bi Che read גֹּרְשׁוּ‎ be driven from.

דֶּ֫שֶׁא‎ noun masculineIsa 15:6 grass (Late Hebrew id., Assyrian dišu, herb, LyonSargontexte 69; Sabean דתֿא‎ fresh shoots DHMZMG 1875, 597 = springtime CISiv. p. 11; Aramaic דִּתְאָה‎, (compare LagBN 130)) — ׳ד‎ absolute Gen 1:11+ 13 t. — accusative of congnate meaning with verb תַּדְשֵׁא‎ 1:11; compare 1:12 (in both, produced by earth); springing out of earth 2Sam 23:4; of a second crop of grass Prov 21:25 (opposed to חָצִיר‎); caused to spring forth by God דֶ֑שֶׁא מֹצָא לְהַצְמִיחַ‎ Job 38:27; refreshed by rain Deut 32:2; ד ׳נְאוֺת‎ Psa 23:2; as food of wild ass Job 6:5; as failing (withered) Isa 15:6; lacking for animals Jer 14:5; דֶּשֶׁא וִירַק‎ simile of weakness 2Kin 19:26 (|| שָׂדֶה עֵשֶׂב‎) = Isa 37:27; of transitoriness (withering) Psa 37:2 (ד ׳יֶרֶק‎); of growth and prosperity, Isa 66:14.
